Dirt Block.name: Dirt Block
Dirt Block.tooltip: Check out my dirt blocks; they are extra dirty.

Stone Block.name: Stone Block
Stone Block.tooltip: The Stone Block is a type of block that is generated naturally in very large parts of the world.

Iron Broadsword.name: Iron Broadsword

Mushroom.name: Mushroom
Mushroom.tooltip: The Mushroom is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion that spawns randomly on grass or Hallowed grass on the surface layer.

Iron Shortsword.name: Iron Shortsword
Iron Shortsword.tooltip: The Iron Shortsword is a pre-Hardmode shortsword. In Journey Mode, the Iron Shortsword replaces the Copper Shortsword for newly created characters.

Iron Hammer.name: Iron Hammer
Iron Hammer.tooltip: The Iron Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer. Newly created characters spawn with an Iron Hammer in Journey Mode.

Torch.name: Torch
Torch.tooltip: You want apples? You want carrots?

Wood.name: Wood
Wood.tooltip: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw.

Iron Axe.name: Iron Axe
Iron Axe.tooltip: The Iron Axe is a pre-Hardmode axe. In Journey Mode(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions), the Iron Axe replaces the Copper Axe for newly created characters.

Iron Ore.name: Iron Ore
Iron Ore.tooltip: Iron Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It spawns in the Underground and Cavern layers, and occasionally on the surface.

Copper Watch.name: Copper Watch
Copper Watch.tooltip: The Copper Watch is a low-tier watch. It enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, accurate to the last hour (one minute in real time).

Silver Watch.name: Silver Watch
Silver Watch.tooltip: The Silver Watch is a mid-tier watch. It enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, accurate to the last half hour (half a minute in real time).

Gold Watch.name: Gold Watch
Gold Watch.tooltip: The Gold Watch is a high-tier watch. It enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, accurate to the last minute (one second in real time).

Depth Meter.name: Depth Meter
Depth Meter.tooltip: The Depth Meter is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the player's vertical position, or depth.
Depth Meter.drops_summary: Most bats (1%), Crawdad (1.25%), Giant Shelly (1.25%), +1 more

Gold Bar.name: Gold Bar
Gold Bar.tooltip: The Gold Bar is is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Copper Bar.name: Copper Bar
Copper Bar.tooltip: The Copper Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Gel.name: Gel
Gel.tooltip: Gel is a common crafting material dropped by most slimes and Slimed Zombies.

Wooden Sword.name: Wooden Sword
Wooden Sword.tooltip: The Wooden Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword.

Wooden Door.name: Wooden Door
Wooden Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Stone Wall.name: Stone Wall
Stone Wall.tooltip: Stone Wall is a background wall made from Stone Blocks.

Acorn.name: Acorn
Acorn.tooltip: The Acorn is a type of seed used to plant trees. Acorns can be planted on regular green grass, Hallowed grass, Corrupt grass, Crimson grass, Jungle grass, Sand, or Snow, where they will create saplings that will grow into trees, under the right conditions.

Lesser Healing Potion.name: Lesser Healing Potion
Lesser Healing Potion.tooltip: The Lesser Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 50 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used.
Lesser Healing Potion.drops_summary: Brain of Cthulhu (100%), Chest (50%), Eater of Worlds (100%), +5 more

Life Crystal.name: Life Crystal
Life Crystal.tooltip: The Life Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's health capacity by 20, adding a red heart to the player's health bar, while also restoring 20 health.

Dirt Wall.name: Dirt Wall
Dirt Wall.tooltip: The Dirt Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in most caves and under overhangs on the surface, considered unsafe.

Bottle.name: Bottle
Bottle.tooltip: A Bottle is a crafting material required to craft most potions.

Wooden Table.name: Wooden Table
Wooden Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Furnace.name: Furnace
Furnace.tooltip: The Furnace is a crafting station used mainly to smelt ores into bars and create various furniture.

Wooden Chair.name: Wooden Chair
Wooden Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Iron Anvil.name: Iron Anvil
Iron Anvil.tooltip: The Iron Anvil and Lead Anvil are pre-Hardmode crafting stations used mainly to craft weapons and armor . Both anvils can craft the same items. Most of their recipes require metal bars , although they are also used to make other items, such as the Jungle tier of equipment. An anvil is a vital crafting station for most of the game, as it is used to make items from every tier up to Cobalt and Palladium , after which it must be replaced by a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil .

Work Bench.name: Work Bench
Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items.

Goggles.name: Goggles
Goggles.tooltip: Goggles are a piece of armor placed in the helmet slot.

Lens.name: Lens
Lens.tooltip: Keep your eye on the prize, buy a lens!

Wooden Bow.name: Wooden Bow
Wooden Bow.tooltip: The Wooden Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Wooden Arrow.name: Wooden Arrow
Wooden Arrow.tooltip: The Wooden Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition.

Flaming Arrow.name: Flaming Arrow
Flaming Arrow.tooltip: The Flaming Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the On Fire!

Shuriken.name: Shuriken
Shuriken.tooltip: The Shuriken is a consumable ranged weapon. It can hit up to 4 targets.

Suspicious Looking Eye.name: Suspicious Looking Eye
Suspicious Looking Eye.tooltip: The Suspicious Looking Eye is a boss-summoning item that summons the Eye of Cthulhu when used.

Demon Bow.name: Demon Bow
Demon Bow.tooltip: The Demon Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

War Axe of the Night.name: War Axe of the Night
War Axe of the Night.tooltip: The War Axe of the Night is a pre-Hardmode axe.

Light's Bane.name: Light's Bane
Light's Bane.tooltip: The Light's Bane is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates a dark slash near the tip of the sword.

Unholy Arrow.name: Unholy Arrow
Unholy Arrow.tooltip: The Unholy Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.
Unholy Arrow.drops_summary: Eye of Cthulhu (100%), Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu) (100%)

Chest.name: Chest
Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5.

Band of Regeneration.name: Band of Regeneration
Band of Regeneration.tooltip: The Band of Regeneration is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern biomes and in Living Mahogany Trees in the Underground Jungle.

Magic Mirror.name: Magic Mirror
Magic Mirror.tooltip: The Magic Mirror is a pre-Hardmode tool. When used, it plays an animation before teleporting the player to their spawn point.

Jester's Arrow.name: Jester's Arrow
Jester's Arrow.tooltip: The Jester's Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

Angel Statue.name: Angel Statue
Angel Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Cloud in a Bottle.name: Cloud in a Bottle
Cloud in a Bottle.tooltip: The Cloud in a Bottle is an accessory that can be found in Gold Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers.

Hermes Boots.name: Hermes Boots
Hermes Boots.tooltip: The Hermes Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory that can be found in Chests in the Underground and Cavern layers.

Enchanted Boomerang.name: Enchanted Boomerang
Enchanted Boomerang.tooltip: The Enchanted Boomerang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang.

Demonite Ore.name: Demonite Ore
Demonite Ore.tooltip: Demonite Ore is a pre-Hardmode ore. It is primarily dropped from the Eater of Worlds, as well as the Eye of Cthulhu in Corruption worlds.

Demonite Bar.name: Demonite Bar
Demonite Bar.tooltip: The Demonite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Heart.name: Heart
Heart.tooltip: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies, broken pots, or as a bonus drop from slimes.

Corrupt Seeds.name: Corrupt Seeds
Corrupt Seeds.tooltip: Corrupt Seeds are seeds which can be planted on Dirt Blocks to create Corrupt grass, which will then spread The Corruption in all directions.
Corrupt Seeds.drops_summary: Eye of Cthulhu (100%), Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu) (100%)

Vile Mushroom.name: Vile Mushroom
Vile Mushroom.tooltip: The Vile Mushroom is a type of mushroom found on grass in the Corruption, where they can be cut and collected with a single swing from any weapon or tool.

Ebonstone Block.name: Ebonstone Block

Grass Seeds.name: Grass Seeds
Grass Seeds.tooltip: Grass Seeds are used to plant regular grass on Dirt Blocks.

Sunflower.name: Sunflower
Sunflower.tooltip: The Sunflower is a large, tall plant which can be found growing naturally on grass, and can be broken with a pickaxe or drill, or by coming into contact with water.

Vilethorn.name: Vilethorn
Vilethorn.drops_summary: Corrupt Crate (20%), Defiled Crate (20%), Shadow Orb (20%)

Starfury.name: Starfury
Starfury.tooltip: The Starfury is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being found inside Skyware Chests on Floating Islands, as well as a 1/4 (25%) chance of being obtained from Sky Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and Azure Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).
Starfury.drops_summary: Azure Crate (25%), Sky Crate (25%), Skyware Chest (25%)

Purification Powder.tooltip: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their Crimson or Corrupt forms. Worm Tooth.name: Worm Tooth

Worm Food.name: Worm Food

Copper Coin.tooltip: Coins are the main unit of currency in Terraria , primarily used for transactions with NPCs . The currency comprises four different metals, making four types of coins: Copper Coins , Silver Coins , Gold Coins , and Platinum Coins . Coins can also be used as ammunition for the Coin Gun .

Fallen Star.tooltip: The Fallen Star is an item that randomly falls from the sky at night and disappears at dawn (4:30 AM).

Copper Greaves.tooltip: Copper armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Copper Helmet , Copper Chainmail , and Copper Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 48 Copper Bars (144 Copper Ore ). The full set grants 6 defense while equipped.

Grappling Hook.name: Grappling Hook
Grappling Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Chain.name: Chain
Chain.tooltip: Chains are used both for climbing and as components for various crafting recipes.

Shadow Scale.name: Shadow Scale
Shadow Scale.tooltip: Shadow Scales are a crafting material dropped from the Eater of Worlds.
Shadow Scale.drops_summary: Eater of Worlds (100%), Eater of Worlds (50%), Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds) (100%)

Piggy Bank.name: Piggy Bank
Piggy Bank.tooltip: The Piggy Bank is a portable storage item which can be purchased from the Merchant for 1 GC.

Mining Helmet.name: Mining Helmet
Mining Helmet.tooltip: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Shirt , and Mining Pants , as well as two different headpieces: the Mining Helmet and Ultrabright Helmet (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for 4 GC and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 (5%) chance. The Mining Shirt and Mining Pants are dropped from Undead Miners with a 3/25 (12%) chance.

Gold Helmet.tooltip: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet , Gold Chainmail , and Gold Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore ). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Wood Wall.name: Wood Wall
Wood Wall.tooltip: Wood Walls are a background wall made from Wood. Like other walls, it stops enemies from spawning when it is placed and can be used for houses.

Wood Platform.name: Wood Platform
Wood Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Flintlock Pistol.name: Flintlock Pistol
Flintlock Pistol.tooltip: The Flintlock Pistol is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be bought from the Arms Dealer for 5 GC.

Musket.name: Musket
Musket.tooltip: The Musket is a pre-Hardmode gun. It will always drop from the first Shadow Orb destroyed in a Corruption world (along with 100 Musket Balls) and has a 1/5 (20%) chance of dropping from destroyed Shadow Orbs afterward.

Musket Ball.name: Musket Ball
Musket Ball.tooltip: The Musket Ball is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It has no special properties and is used for crafting a variety of more advanced ammunition.

Minishark.name: Minishark
Minishark.tooltip: I see you're eyeballin' the Minishark.. You really don't want to know how it was made.

Iron Bow.name: Iron Bow
Iron Bow.tooltip: The Iron Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow.

Shadow Greaves.name: Shadow Greaves
Shadow Greaves.tooltip: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet , Shadow Scalemail , and Shadow Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore ) and 45 Shadow Scales .

Shadow Scalemail.name: Shadow Scalemail
Shadow Scalemail.tooltip: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet , Shadow Scalemail , and Shadow Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore ) and 45 Shadow Scales .

Shadow Helmet.name: Shadow Helmet
Shadow Helmet.tooltip: Shadow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadow Helmet , Shadow Scalemail , and Shadow Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Demonite Bars (180 Demonite Ore ) and 45 Shadow Scales .

Nightmare Pickaxe.name: Nightmare Pickaxe
Nightmare Pickaxe.tooltip: The Nightmare Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode, post-Eater of Worlds pickaxe.

The Breaker.name: The Breaker
The Breaker.tooltip: The Breaker is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Candle.name: Candle
Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source. Candles can be placed on Tables, Platforms, Crates or Work Benches.

Copper Chandelier.name: Copper Chandelier
Copper Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Silver Chandelier.name: Silver Chandelier
Silver Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Gold Chandelier.name: Gold Chandelier

Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Mana Crystal.name: Mana Crystal
Mana Crystal.tooltip: The Mana Crystal is a permanent booster item that permanently increases the player's maximum mana by 20, up to a maximum of 200 total.

Lesser Mana Potion.name: Lesser Mana Potion
Lesser Mana Potion.tooltip: The Lesser Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 50 mana when used and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use.

Band of Starpower.name: Band of Starpower
Band of Starpower.tooltip: The Band of Starpower is an accessory that increases the player's maximum mana by 20.
Band of Starpower.drops_summary: Corrupt Crate (20%), Defiled Crate (20%), Shadow Orb (20%)

Flower of Fire.name: Flower of Fire
Flower of Fire.tooltip: The Flower of Fire is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand that fires a slow, non-piercing fireball that can bounce off blocks up to five times.

Magic Missile.name: Magic Missile
Magic Missile.tooltip: The Magic Missile is a pre-Hardmode wand. When used, it fires a magic missile that follows the cursor when ⚒ Use / Attack key is held.

Dirt Rod.name: Dirt Rod
Dirt Rod.tooltip: The Dirt Rod is a unique tool that is used solely to move Dirt Blocks around, and is unlike the use of ordinary mining tools and block placement.

Shadow Orb.name: Shadow Orb
Shadow Orb.tooltip: The Shadow Orb is a floating, purple, spherical background object found deep in the chasms of the Corruption.

Meteorite.name: Meteorite
Meteorite.tooltip: Meteorite is a pre-Hardmode ore typically mined from Meteorite crash sites.

Meteorite Bar.name: Meteorite Bar
Meteorite Bar.tooltip: The Meteorite Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar. Meteorite Bars can also be found as common items in Shadow Chests, or more rarely in Gold Chests in the Cavern layer that generate close to the Underworld.

Hook.name: Hook
Hook.tooltip: The Hook is a crafting material used solely to craft the Grappling Hook.

Flamarang.name: Flamarang
Flamarang.tooltip: The Flamarang is a pre-Hardmode boomerang and an upgrade to the Enchanted Boomerang.

Molten Fury.name: Molten Fury
Molten Fury.tooltip: The Molten Fury is a pre-Hardmode bow. When used, it converts Wooden Arrows into Flaming Arrows, causing them to inflict the On Fire!

Volcano.name: Volcano
Volcano.tooltip: The Volcano is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it creates an explosion upon enemy hits, dealing 75% of the weapon's damage (30 base damage) to the enemy and 2 other targets in an area around the enemy.

Molten Pickaxe.name: Molten Pickaxe
Molten Pickaxe.tooltip: The Molten Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Dungeon Bricks, Cobalt Ore, and Palladium Ore.

Meteor Helmet.name: Meteor Helmet
Meteor Helmet.tooltip: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet , Meteor Suit , and Meteor Leggings . Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite ).

Meteor Suit.name: Meteor Suit
Meteor Suit.tooltip: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet , Meteor Suit , and Meteor Leggings . Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite ).

Meteor Leggings.name: Meteor Leggings
Meteor Leggings.tooltip: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet , Meteor Suit , and Meteor Leggings . Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Meteorite Bars (135 Meteorite ).

Bottled Water.name: Bottled Water
Bottled Water.tooltip: Bottled Water is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion.

Space Gun.name: Space Gun
Space Gun.tooltip: The Space Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun. When used, it fires fast green lasers that can pierce two enemies.

Rocket Boots.name: Rocket Boots
Rocket Boots.tooltip: Rocket science gave us Rocket Boots.

Gray Brick.name: Gray Brick
Gray Brick.tooltip: Gray Brick is a basic brick. It is often used in construction, as it requires only common Stone blocks to produce and, unlike its constituent materials, is resistant to the spread of Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow.

Gray Brick Wall.name: Gray Brick Wall
Gray Brick Wall.tooltip: Gray Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Gray Bricks.

Red Brick.name: Red Brick
Red Brick.tooltip: Red Bricks are bricks crafted from Clay Block.

Red Brick Wall.name: Red Brick Wall
Red Brick Wall.tooltip: Red Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Red Bricks.

Blue Brick.name: Blue Brick
Blue Brick.tooltip: Dungeon Bricks are a non-craftable type of brick from which the Dungeon is constructed. On world generation, one of three colors of Dungeon Brick is chosen to create the entirety of the Dungeon. Dungeon Brick is one of very few block types that is impervious to explosions . 100% Pickaxe power (a Molten Pickaxe or better) is required to mine Dungeon Bricks in the Underground -level Dungeon, although any pickaxe can mine Dungeon Bricks at or above the Surface layer, and any Dungeon Bricks placed within the center third of the world.

Blue Brick Wall.name: Blue Brick Wall
Blue Brick Wall.tooltip: Dungeon Brick Walls are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Dungeon , considered unsafe . They drop as items when destroyed, and can also be obtained via crafting on Desktop , Console , and Mobile . They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

Chain Lantern.name: Chain Lantern
Chain Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Gold Brick.tooltip: Gold Bricks are a type of brick crafted from Gold Ore.

Gold Brick Wall.name: Gold Brick Wall
Gold Brick Wall.tooltip: The Gold Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds.

Silver Brick.name: Silver Brick
Silver Brick.tooltip: Silver Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material.

Silver Brick Wall.name: Silver Brick Wall
Silver Brick Wall.tooltip: Silver Brick Walls are a type of background wall crafted from Silver Bricks.

Copper Brick.name: Copper Brick
Copper Brick.tooltip: Copper Brick is a type of Brick and an aesthetic building material.

Copper Brick Wall.name: Copper Brick Wall
Copper Brick Wall.tooltip: Copper Brick Walls are a type of background wall crafted from Copper Bricks.

Spike.name: Spike
Spike.tooltip: Spikes are a type of trap block that deal (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 60 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 40 damage to players who come in contact with them.

Water Candle.name: Water Candle
Water Candle.tooltip: The Water Candle is a furniture item that can be placed or held to increase enemy and critter spawn rates in the area, and emits a low amount of light.

Book.name: Book
Book.tooltip: The Book is a crafting material used only to craft Bookcases and Pianos.

Cobweb.name: Cobweb
Cobweb.tooltip: Cobwebs are crafting materials used to craft Silk and other items.

Necro Helmet.name: Necro Helmet
Necro Helmet.tooltip: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode , post- Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet , Necro Breastplate , and Necro Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones .

Necro Breastplate.name: Necro Breastplate
Necro Breastplate.tooltip: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode , post- Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet , Necro Breastplate , and Necro Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones .

Necro Greaves.name: Necro Greaves
Necro Greaves.tooltip: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode , post- Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet , Necro Breastplate , and Necro Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones .

Bone.name: Bone
Bone.tooltip: Got any spare bones for sale? I'm looking to replace my broken hip...

Muramasa.name: Muramasa
Muramasa.tooltip: The Muramasa is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron broadsword that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).

Cobalt Shield.name: Cobalt Shield
Cobalt Shield.tooltip: The Cobalt Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield accessory that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions).

Aqua Scepter.name: Aqua Scepter
Aqua Scepter.tooltip: The Aqua Scepter is a pre-Hardmode wand that fires arcing streams of water in quick succession.

Lucky Horseshoe.name: Lucky Horseshoe
Lucky Horseshoe.tooltip: The Lucky Horseshoe is an accessory that primarily negates fall damage.
Lucky Horseshoe.drops_summary: Azure Crate (25%), Sky Crate (25%), Skyware Chest (25%)

Shiny Red Balloon.name: Shiny Red Balloon
Shiny Red Balloon.tooltip: The Shiny Red Balloon is an accessory that increases the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%, increasing the height that the player can jump from 6 tiles to ~10½ tiles, effectively a ~75% boost.
Shiny Red Balloon.drops_summary: Azure Crate (25%), Sky Crate (25%), Skyware Chest (25%)

Harpoon.name: Harpoon
Harpoon.tooltip: The Harpoon is a unique pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that auto-fires an arcing spear projectile connected to the player via a chain and returns after reaching a maximum distance or upon impact with an enemy or surface.

Spiky Ball.name: Spiky Ball
Spiky Ball.tooltip: The Spiky Ball is a consumable ranged weapon that is primarily used as a passive trap by tossing them to the ground, where enemies who pass over them will take damage up to 7 times (after which the Spiky Balls vanish).

Ball O' Hurt.name: Ball O' Hurt
Ball O' Hurt.tooltip: The Ball O' Hurt is a pre-Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being obtained from destroying Shadow Orbs found in The Corruption or a 1/5 (20%) chance from Corrupt Crates and Defiled Crates, which are fished in the Corruption.
Ball O' Hurt.drops_summary: Corrupt Crate (20%), Defiled Crate (20%), Shadow Orb (20%)

Blue Moon.name: Blue Moon
Blue Moon.tooltip: The Blue Moon is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from the Locked Gold Chests found in the Dungeon, as well as a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Golden Lock Boxes.

Handgun.name: Handgun
Handgun.tooltip: The Handgun is a pre-Hardmode gun that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being obtained from Locked Gold Chests in the Dungeon, and from Golden Lock Boxes found in Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates.

Water Bolt.name: Water Bolt
Water Bolt.tooltip: The Water Bolt is a pre-Hardmode spell book that can only be found hidden within the shelves of the Dungeon.

Bomb.name: Bomb
Bomb.tooltip: The Bomb is an explosive which can be purchased from the Demolitionist and Skeleton Merchant for 3 SC each or obtained from Pots, Chests, slimes, by powering Bomb Statues, or as a drop from Undead Miners with a 18/25 (72%) chance.
Bomb.drops_summary: Most slimes (0.31%), Gold Chest (33.33%), Undead Miner (72%)

Dynamite.name: Dynamite
Dynamite.tooltip: Dynamite, my own special cure-all for what ails ya.

Grenade.name: Grenade
Grenade.tooltip: Would you rather have a bullet hole or a grenade hole?

Sand Block.name: Sand Block
Sand Block.tooltip: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes, at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer.

Glass.name: Glass
Glass.tooltip: Glass is crafted from different types of sand at a Furnace.

Sign.name: Sign
Sign.tooltip: The Sign is a decorative furniture item that can store a player-written message.

Ash Block.name: Ash Block
Ash Block.tooltip: The Ash Block is a block that covers the upper and lower sections of The Underworld, and can occasionally encase Hellstone.

Obsidian.name: Obsidian
Obsidian.tooltip: Obsidian is a pre-Hardmode ore that is created when water and lava collide.

Hellstone.name: Hellstone
Hellstone.tooltip: The underworld is made of a material called hellstone.

Hellstone Bar.name: Hellstone Bar
Hellstone Bar.tooltip: The Hellstone Bar is a pre-Hardmode bar.

Mud Block.name: Mud Block
Mud Block.tooltip: Mud Blocks are a very common block type that comprises the majority of the Jungle, Underground Jungle, and Glowing Mushroom biome.

Sapphire.name: Sapphire
Sapphire.tooltip: Sapphire is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Ruby.name: Ruby
Ruby.tooltip: Ruby is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Emerald.name: Emerald
Emerald.tooltip: Emerald is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Topaz.name: Topaz
Topaz.tooltip: Topaz is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Amethyst.name: Amethyst
Amethyst.tooltip: Amethyst is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Diamond.name: Diamond
Diamond.tooltip: Diamond is a gem found within the Underground and Cavern layers of a world.

Glowing Mushroom.name: Glowing Mushroom
Glowing Mushroom.tooltip: The Glowing Mushroom is a plant, crafting material, and block that can be found on Mushroom grass in the Glowing Mushroom biome.

Star.name: Star
Star.tooltip: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24 (54.17%), as long as the player is below maximum mana.

Ivy Whip.name: Ivy Whip
Ivy Whip.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Breathing Reed.name: Breathing Reed
Breathing Reed.tooltip: The Breathing Reed is a tool that aids in underwater breathing, and also functions as a broadsword.
Breathing Reed.drops_summary: Ocean Crate (22.5%), Seaside Crate (22.5%), Water Chest (22.5%)

Flipper.name: Flipper
Flipper.tooltip: The Flipper is an accessory that allows a player to swim in liquids.
Flipper.drops_summary: Ocean Crate (22.5%), Seaside Crate (22.5%), Water Chest (22.5%)

Healing Potion.name: Healing Potion
Healing Potion.tooltip: The Healing Potion is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that restores 100 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used.
Healing Potion.drops_summary: Most crates (25%), Deerclops (100%), Gold Chest (50%), +2 more

Mana Potion.name: Mana Potion
Mana Potion.tooltip: The Mana Potion is a recovery potion that restores 100 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use.

Blade of Grass.name: Blade of Grass
Blade of Grass.tooltip: The Blade of Grass is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it fires a Leaf Blade projectile that travels upwards in a circle and homes in on enemies.

Thorn Chakram.name: Thorn Chakram
Thorn Chakram.tooltip: The Thorn Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang. Unlike most boomerangs, it does not necessarily return immediately upon contact with objects, but instead can bounce off blocks before returning.

Obsidian Brick.name: Obsidian Brick
Obsidian Brick.tooltip: The Obsidian Brick is a brick-block mainly used for building.

Obsidian Skull.name: Obsidian Skull
Obsidian Skull.tooltip: The Obsidian Skull is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants +1 defense and immunity to the Burning debuff inflicted upon contact with Meteorite, Hellstone, and Hellstone Bricks.

Mushroom Grass Seeds.name: Mushroom Grass Seeds
Mushroom Grass Seeds.tooltip: Mushroom Grass Seeds are a type of seed that has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance to drop from harvesting Glowing Mushrooms.

Jungle Grass Seeds.name: Jungle Grass Seeds
Jungle Grass Seeds.tooltip: Jungle Grass Seeds are a type of seed that can be planted in Mud Blocks to grow Jungle grass, potentially creating an artificial Jungle or Underground Jungle (depending on depth) if enough Jungle grass and plants are created.

Wooden Hammer.name: Wooden Hammer
Wooden Hammer.tooltip: The Wooden Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Star Cannon.name: Star Cannon
Star Cannon.tooltip: The Star Cannon is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that consumes and fires Fallen Stars.

Blue Phaseblade.name: Blue Phaseblade
Blue Phaseblade.tooltip: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords . There are seven different color variations with identical statistics. All phaseblades emit a small amount of light when swung.

Red Phaseblade.name: Red Phaseblade

Meteor Hamaxe.name: Meteor Hamaxe
Meteor Hamaxe.tooltip: The Meteor Hamaxe is a pre-Hardmode hamaxe. It combines the functionality of a hammer and an axe.

Empty Bucket.name: Empty Bucket
Empty Bucket.tooltip: Buckets are tools used to carry water , lava , or honey , allowing them to be removed or placed. With an Empty Bucket , pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button on any sufficient body of liquid collects it, which replaces the Empty Bucket with the respective Water Bucket , Lava Bucket , or Honey Bucket . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button again will deposit the liquid at the location of the cursor, wherein the filled bucket is again replaced with an Empty Bucket. Each bucket holds one tile of liquid. Shimmer cannot be collected with standard buckets.

Water Bucket.name: Water Bucket
Water Bucket.tooltip: Buckets are tools used to carry water , lava , or honey , allowing them to be removed or placed. With an Empty Bucket , pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button on any sufficient body of liquid collects it, which replaces the Empty Bucket with the respective Water Bucket , Lava Bucket , or Honey Bucket . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button again will deposit the liquid at the location of the cursor, wherein the filled bucket is again replaced with an Empty Bucket. Each bucket holds one tile of liquid. Shimmer cannot be collected with standard buckets.

Jungle Rose.name: Jungle Rose
Jungle Rose.tooltip: The Jungle Rose is a vanity accessory which can be harvested from the floor of the Jungle and Underground Jungle.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.tooltip: The Stinger is a crafting material used in various Jungle-themed crafting recipes.
Stinger.drops_summary: Hornet (66%), Moss Hornet (16.67%), Spiked Jungle Slime (50%)

Vine.name: Vine
Vine.tooltip: Vines are crafting materials dropped by Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle biome with a 1/2 (50%) / 100% drop chance.

Feral Claws.name: Feral Claws
Feral Claws.tooltip: Feral Claws are an accessory that increases melee attack speed by 12%, and stacks with all other attack speed boosts.
Feral Claws.drops_summary: Bramble Crate (19%), Ivy Chest (21.72%), Jungle Crate (19%)

Anklet of the Wind.name: Anklet of the Wind
Anklet of the Wind.tooltip: The Anklet of the Wind is an accessory that gives a 10% bonus to movement speed.
Anklet of the Wind.drops_summary: Bramble Crate (19%), Ivy Chest (21.72%), Jungle Crate (19%)

Staff of Regrowth.name: Staff of Regrowth
Staff of Regrowth.tooltip: The Staff of Regrowth is a tool that can be found in Ivy Chests as well as Jungle and Bramble Crates.
Staff of Regrowth.drops_summary: Bramble Crate (19%), Ivy Chest (21.72%), Jungle Crate (19%)

Hellstone Brick.name: Hellstone Brick
Hellstone Brick.tooltip: Hellstone Bricks are placeable blocks that occur naturally in unique Ruined Houses, though they can also be crafted.

Whoopie Cushion.name: Whoopie Cushion
Whoopie Cushion.tooltip: The Whoopie Cushion is a novelty item that makes a farting sound when used.

Shackle.name: Shackle
Shackle.tooltip: The Shackle is an accessory that grants 1 point of defense.

Molten Hamaxe.name: Molten Hamaxe
Molten Hamaxe.tooltip: The Molten Hamaxe is a pre-Hardmode hamaxe. It has a chance to inflict the On Fire!

Flamelash.name: Flamelash
Flamelash.tooltip: The Flamelash is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron wand.

Phoenix Blaster.name: Phoenix Blaster
Phoenix Blaster.tooltip: The Phoenix Blaster is a pre-Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Handgun, with increased damage and velocity but slightly less knockback.

Sunfury.name: Sunfury
Sunfury.tooltip: The Sunfury is a pre-Hardmode, post-Skeletron flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld, as well as a 1/5 (20%) chance of being found in Obsidian Lock Boxes obtained from Obsidian Crates and Hellstone Crates.

Hellforge.name: Hellforge
Hellforge.tooltip: The Hellforge is a crafting station that functions as a regular Furnace, with the additional ability of smelting Hellstone into Hellstone Bars.

Clay Pot.name: Clay Pot
Clay Pot.tooltip: The Clay Pot is a furniture item in which a herb or flower seed can be planted.

Nature's Gift.name: Nature's Gift
Nature's Gift.tooltip: Nature's Gift is an accessory that reduces the mana cost of using magic weapons and other mana-consuming items by 6%.

Bed.name: Bed
Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed.

Silk.name: Silk
Silk.tooltip: Silk is an item used to craft the Bed, as well as several placeable decorative items and vanity clothing items.

Lesser Restoration Potion.name: Lesser Restoration Potion
Lesser Restoration Potion.tooltip: The Lesser Restoration Potion is a recovery potion that combines the effects of the Lesser Healing Potion and Lesser Mana Potion .

Restoration Potion.name: Restoration Potion
Restoration Potion.tooltip: The Restoration Potion is a recovery potion that can be found in Shadow Chests in the Underworld.

Jungle Hat.name: Jungle Hat

Jungle Shirt.name: Jungle Shirt

Molten Helmet.name: Molten Helmet
Molten Helmet.tooltip: Molten armor is a pre-Hardmode melee armor set consisting of the Molten Helmet , Molten Breastplate , and Molten Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 45 Hellstone Bars (135 Hellstone and 45 Obsidian ).

Molten Breastplate.name: Molten Breastplate

Molten Greaves.name: Molten Greaves

Meteor Shot.name: Meteor Shot
Meteor Shot.tooltip: The Meteor Shot is a pre-Hardmode bullet. When fired, it can either bounce from a solid block once or pierce through one enemy.

Sticky Bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
Sticky Bomb.tooltip: Sticky Bombs are a type of explosive crafted from Bombs and Gel.

Black Lens.name: Black Lens
Black Lens.tooltip: The Black Lens is a crafting material dropped by Demon Eyes and Wandering Eyes at a 1/100 (1%) chance.

Sunglasses.name: Sunglasses
Sunglasses.tooltip: The Sunglasses are a vanity item equipped in the social helmet slot.

Wizard Hat.name: Wizard Hat
Wizard Hat.tooltip: The Wizard Hat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece that can be equipped in the helmet slot.

Goldfish.name: Goldfish

Robe.name: Robe

Cactus.name: Cactus

Feather.name: Feather

Tombstone.name: Tombstone

Illegal Gun Parts.name: Illegal Gun Parts
Illegal Gun Parts.tooltip: Illegal Gun Parts are a crafting material used to craft the Sandgun, the Megashark, and the Flamethrower.

The Doctor's Shirt.name: The Doctor's Shirt

Shadow Key.name: Shadow Key
Shadow Key.tooltip: The Shadow Key is an item used solely to open Shadow Chests found scattered in the Underworld and Obsidian Lock Boxes found from Obsidian and Hellstone Crates.

Obsidian Brick Wall.name: Obsidian Brick Wall
Obsidian Brick Wall.tooltip: The Obsidian Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Ruined Houses in the Underworld, considered unsafe.

Jungle Spores.name: Jungle Spores
Jungle Spores.tooltip: Jungle Spores are crafting materials acquired by destroying green glowing orbs that grow randomly on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle, in or below the Cavern layer.

Loom.name: Loom
Loom.tooltip: The Loom is a crafting station used to craft Silk, as well as some items that require Silk as an ingredient.

Piano.name: Piano
Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture. They also count as a flat surface item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house.

Dresser.name: Dresser
Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item.

Bench.name: Bench
Bench.tooltip: Benches are decorative furniture items that can take the place of chairs for the comfort requirement in NPCs ' housing .

Bathtub.name: Bathtub
Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house's requirement of a flat-surface item.

Banners can be hung off of blocks and off of platforms which are in (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) any position / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) their bottom position (after being struck three times with a hammer ).

Safe.name: Safe

Skull Lantern.name: Skull Lantern

Trash Can.name: Trash Can

Mug.name: Mug

Keg.name: Keg

Armor Statue.name: Armor Statue
Armor Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

GPS.name: GPS
GPS.tooltip: The GPS is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the in-game time, the player's horizontal position, and their depth.

Obsidian Horseshoe.name: Obsidian Horseshoe
Obsidian Horseshoe.tooltip: The Obsidian Horseshoe is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the following effects while equipped:

Obsidian Shield.name: Obsidian Shield
Obsidian Shield.tooltip: The Obsidian Shield is a pre-Hardmode shield and immunity accessory that grants +2 defense, immunity to knockback, and immunity to the Burning debuff.

Tinkerer's Workshop.name: Tinkerer's Workshop
Tinkerer's Workshop.tooltip: The Tinkerer's Workshop is a crafting station that is used primarily to combine multiple accessories into single items that usually provide the abilities of their components.

Cloud in a Balloon.name: Cloud in a Balloon
Cloud in a Balloon.tooltip: The Cloud in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functionality of the Cloud in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.

Adamantite Headgear.name: Adamantite Headgear
Adamantite Headgear.tooltip: Adamantite armor is a Hardmode armor set consisting of the Adamantite Breastplate and Adamantite Leggings , as well as three different headpieces: the Adamantite Helmet , Adamantite Mask , and Adamantite Headgear , providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively. Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Adamantite Bars (216 Adamantite Ore ). Crafting all five pieces requires a total of 78 Adamantite Bars (312 Adamantite Ore).

Adamantite Glaive.name: Adamantite Glaive
Adamantite Glaive.tooltip: The Adamantite Glaive is a Hardmode spear.

Toolbelt.name: Toolbelt
Toolbelt.tooltip: The Toolbelt is an accessory item purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 GC that increases the range of block placement by one tile, although it does not increase block mining range.

Pearlsand Block.name: Pearlsand Block
Pearlsand Block.tooltip: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes , at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions . Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below ).

Pearlstone Block.name: Pearlstone Block
Pearlstone Block.tooltip: The Pearlstone Block is a Hardmode block type found in The Hallow.

Mining Shirt.name: Mining Shirt
Mining Shirt.tooltip: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Shirt , and Mining Pants , as well as two different headpieces: the Mining Helmet and Ultrabright Helmet (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for 4 GC and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 (5%) chance. The Mining Shirt and Mining Pants are dropped from Undead Miners with a 3/25 (12%) chance.

Mining Pants.name: Mining Pants
Mining Pants.tooltip: Mining armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Mining Shirt , and Mining Pants , as well as two different headpieces: the Mining Helmet and Ultrabright Helmet (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . The Mining Helmet can be purchased from the Merchant for 4 GC and can also be dropped by Undead Miners with a 1/20 (5%) chance. The Mining Shirt and Mining Pants are dropped from Undead Miners with a 3/25 (12%) chance.

Pearlstone Brick.name: Pearlstone Brick
Pearlstone Brick.tooltip: Pearlstone Brick is a brick made from Pearlstone. It does not spread The Hallow when placed, therefore making it a safer construction material than its raw ingredients.

Iridescent Brick.name: Iridescent Brick
Iridescent Brick.tooltip: Iridescent Brick is a cheap brick. It can be mined with any pickaxe or drill.

Mudstone Brick.name: Mudstone Brick
Mudstone Brick.tooltip: The Mudstone Brick is a type of brick made from Stone Blocks and Mud Blocks.

Cobalt Brick.name: Cobalt Brick
Cobalt Brick.tooltip: Cobalt Brick is a сobalt tier brick. Unlike Cobalt Ore, Cobalt Bricks are not immune to explosives.

Mythril Brick.name: Mythril Brick
Mythril Brick.tooltip: Mythril Brick is a mythril tier brick. Unlike Mythril Ore, Mythril Bricks are not immune to explosives.

Pearlstone Brick Wall.name: Pearlstone Brick Wall
Pearlstone Brick Wall.tooltip: Pearlstone Brick Walls are a type of wall crafted from Pearlstone Bricks.

Iridescent Brick Wall.name: Iridescent Brick Wall
Iridescent Brick Wall.tooltip: The Iridescent Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds.

Mudstone Brick Wall.name: Mudstone Brick Wall
Mudstone Brick Wall.tooltip: The Mudstone Brick Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Jungle Shrines in some worlds.

Cobalt Brick Wall.name: Cobalt Brick Wall
Cobalt Brick Wall.tooltip: Cobalt Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Cobalt Bricks.

Mythril Brick Wall.name: Mythril Brick Wall
Mythril Brick Wall.tooltip: Mythril Brick Wall is a background wall crafted from Mythril Bricks.

Holy Water.name: Holy Water
Holy Water.tooltip: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome ( Hallow , Corruption , or Crimson for Holy Water , Unholy Water , and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. This conversion affects a roughly circular area with a radius of four tiles from the center. Enemies within this radius are also damaged slightly; this damage is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment.

Unholy Water.name: Unholy Water
Unholy Water.tooltip: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome ( Hallow , Corruption , or Crimson for Holy Water , Unholy Water , and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. This conversion affects a roughly circular area with a radius of four tiles from the center. Silt Block.name: Silt Block
Silt Block.tooltip: Silt Blocks are a type of soil that generates in the Underground and Cavern layers, appearing more frequently at lower depths.

Fairy Bell.name: Fairy Bell
Fairy Bell.tooltip: The Fairy Bell is a Hardmode light pet-summoning item that spawns a Fairy, a glowing creature resembling a Pixie, which follows the player and produces light for an unlimited duration.

Breaker Blade.name: Breaker Blade
Breaker Blade.tooltip: The Breaker Blade is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh.
Breaker Blade.drops_summary: Treasure Bag (Wall of Flesh) (25%), Wall of Flesh (25%)

Blue Torch.name: Blue Torch
Blue Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Dual Hook.name: Dual Hook
Dual Hook.tooltip: The Dual Hook is a Hardmode grappling hook that reaches 27.5 tiles and has two hooks which can be launched simultaneously; however, only one hook can be attached to a block at any time.

Star Statue.name: Star Statue
Star Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Planked Wall.tooltip: Planked Wall is a background wall that naturally spawns in Underground Cabins.

Wooden Beam.name: Wooden Beam
Wooden Beam.tooltip: Beams or columns are background furniture items that provide support for Torches and can be used as decoration. They form continuous vertical pillars when stacked. They are found naturally in Underground Cabins , and can be crafted.

Adamantite Repeater.name: Adamantite Repeater
Adamantite Repeater.tooltip: The Adamantite Repeater is a Hardmode repeater.

Adamantite Sword.name: Adamantite Sword
Adamantite Sword.tooltip: The Adamantite Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Cobalt Sword.name: Cobalt Sword
Cobalt Sword.tooltip: The Cobalt Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Mythril Sword.name: Mythril Sword
Mythril Sword.tooltip: The Mythril Sword is a Hardmode broadsword.

Moon Charm.name: Moon Charm
Moon Charm.tooltip: The Moon Charm is a Hardmode accessory that, when equipped during nighttime, transforms the player into a werewolf and applies the Werewolf buff, which provides several stat bonuses.

Ruler.name: Ruler
Ruler.tooltip: The Ruler is a pre-Hardmode shortsword purchased from the Goblin Tinkerer for 10 SC.

Crystal Ball.name: Crystal Ball
Crystal Ball.tooltip: Are you here for a peek at my crystal ball?

Disco Ball.name: Disco Ball
Disco Ball.tooltip: Put up a disco ball and then I'll show you how to party.

Sorcerer Emblem.name: Sorcerer Emblem
Sorcerer Emblem.tooltip: The Sorcerer Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases magic damage by 15%.
Sorcerer Emblem.drops_summary: Treasure Bag (Wall of Flesh) (25%), Wall of Flesh (25%)

Warrior Emblem.name: Warrior Emblem
Warrior Emblem.tooltip: The Warrior Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases melee damage by 15%.
Warrior Emblem.drops_summary: Treasure Bag (Wall of Flesh) (25%), Wall of Flesh (25%)

Ranger Emblem.name: Ranger Emblem
Ranger Emblem.tooltip: The Ranger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases ranged damage by 15%.
Ranger Emblem.drops_summary: Treasure Bag (Wall of Flesh) (25%), Wall of Flesh (25%)

Demon Wings.name: Demon Wings
Demon Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Angel Wings.name: Angel Wings
Angel Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Magical Harp.name: Magical Harp
Magical Harp.tooltip: The Magical Harp is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires ricocheting, piercing projectiles that graphically resemble purple musical notes.

Rainbow Rod.name: Rainbow Rod
Rainbow Rod.tooltip: The Rainbow Rod is a Hardmode, post-The Twins wand.

Ice Rod.name: Ice Rod
Ice Rod.tooltip: The Ice Rod is a Hardmode magic weapon that autofires blocks of ice, which have the unique ability of placing solid, temporary Ice Blocks at the location of the cursor and which last for 15 seconds before shattering.

Neptune's Shell.name: Neptune's Shell
Neptune's Shell.tooltip: Neptune's Shell is a Hardmode accessory that aids maneuverability in water, honey, and shimmer(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) by granting indefinite breathing time while submerged, swimming via the ↷ Jump key, and eliminating the slow movement speed usually caused by submerging underwater.

Mannequin.name: Mannequin
Mannequin.tooltip: The Mannequin is a decorative furniture item that can be used to display armor and vanity items, as well as accessories and dyes.

Greater Healing Potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
Greater Healing Potion.tooltip: The Greater Healing Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 150 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 60 seconds when used.

Greater Mana Potion.name: Greater Mana Potion
Greater Mana Potion.tooltip: The Greater Mana Potion is a Hardmode recovery potion that restores 200 mana and inflicts the Mana Sickness debuff upon use.

Pixie Dust.name: Pixie Dust
Pixie Dust.tooltip: Pixie Dust is a common Hardmode crafting material that always drops from Pixies.

Crystal Shard.name: Crystal Shard
Crystal Shard.tooltip: Crystal Shards are a common Hardmode crafting material found in the Underground Hallow.

Clown Hat.name: Clown Hat
Clown Hat.tooltip: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat , the Clown Shirt , and the Clown Pants . It is purchased from the Clothier for 4 GC (set) , once a Clown has been defeated.

Clown Shirt.name: Clown Shirt
Clown Shirt.tooltip: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat , the Clown Shirt , and the Clown Pants . It is purchased from the Clothier for 4 GC (set) , once a Clown has been defeated.

Clown Pants.name: Clown Pants
Clown Pants.tooltip: The Clown set is a vanity set which consists of the Clown Hat , the Clown Shirt , and the Clown Pants . It is purchased from the Clothier for 4 GC (set) , once a Clown has been defeated.

Flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
Flamethrower.tooltip: The Flamethrower is a Hardmode, post-Skeletron Prime ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition.

Bell.name: Bell
Bell.tooltip: The Bell is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Wizard for 1 GC.

Harp.name: Harp
Harp.tooltip: The Harp is a Hardmode crafting material, used only to craft the Magical Harp.

Red Wrench.name: Red Wrench
Red Wrench.tooltip: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires , which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate . There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench , Green Wrench , Blue Wrench , and Yellow Wrench (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , each placing its respective color of Wire. All wrenches are purchased from the Mechanic for 2 GC each.

Wire Cutter.name: Wire Cutter
Wire Cutter.tooltip: The Wire Cutter is a tool that allows players to free and harvest Wires and Actuators.

Active Stone Block.name: Active Stone Block
Active Stone Block.tooltip: Active Stone Blocks and Inactive Stone Blocks are blocks that act as mechanisms.

Inactive Stone Block.name: Inactive Stone Block
Inactive Stone Block.tooltip: Active Stone Blocks and Inactive Stone Blocks are blocks that act as mechanisms . A given pair behave as a single block whose presence can be switched "on" or "off" using wire and a trigger.

Lever.name: Lever
Lever.tooltip: The Lever is a 2×2 activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for 30 SC.

Laser Rifle.name: Laser Rifle
Laser Rifle.tooltip: The Laser Rifle is a Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/4 (25%) chance of being dropped by the Wall of Flesh.
Laser Rifle.drops_summary: Treasure Bag (Wall of Flesh) (25%), Wall of Flesh (25%)

Crystal Bullet.name: Crystal Bullet
Crystal Bullet.tooltip: The Crystal Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It shatters upon impact with enemies or solid blocks, splitting into two small shards.

Holy Arrow.name: Holy Arrow
Holy Arrow.tooltip: The Holy Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. Upon contact with enemies or blocks, two Hallow Star projectiles will fall from the sky to the impact location.

Magic Dagger.name: Magic Dagger
Magic Dagger.tooltip: The Magic Dagger is a Hardmode magic weapon that operates exactly as the Throwing Knife, but uses mana instead of consuming stacks of the item and causes more than triple the damage.

Crystal Storm.name: Crystal Storm
Crystal Storm.tooltip: The Crystal Storm is a Hardmode spell book that rapidly fires a slight spread of small crystal shards.

Cursed Flames.name: Cursed Flames
Cursed Flames.tooltip: The Cursed Flames is a Hardmode spell book that fires gravity-affected bouncing green fireballs.

Soul of Light.name: Soul of Light
Soul of Light.tooltip: Soul of Light is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Hallow (in the Cavern layer) with a 1/5 (20%) chance.

Soul of Night.name: Soul of Night
Soul of Night.tooltip: Soul of Night is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by most enemies killed in the Underground Corruption or Underground Crimson (in the Cavern layer), with a 1/5 (20%) chance.

Cursed Flame.name: Cursed Flame
Cursed Flame.tooltip: Cursed Flame is a Hardmode crafting material, whose Crimson counterpart is Ichor.

Cursed Torch.name: Cursed Torch
Cursed Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Adamantite Forge.name: Adamantite Forge
Adamantite Forge.tooltip: The Adamantite Forge and Titanium Forge are Hardmode crafting stations that incorporate the same functions as a regular Furnace and Hellforge , with the additional bonus of being able to smelt Adamantite , Titanium and Chlorophyte ores into their respective bars . They give off fire particles like the Furnace and Hellforge.

Mythril Anvil.name: Mythril Anvil
Mythril Anvil.tooltip: The Mythril Anvil and Orichalcum Anvil are Hardmode crafting stations that serve and extend the function of a pre-Hardmode Anvil . These are very crucial to game advancement, as they account for making nearly every Hardmode recipe before the Ancient Manipulator (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . In addition to acting as a direct replacement to Lead and Iron Anvils and inheriting all of their crafting recipes, they further serve the similar function of crafting bars forged of Hardmode ores into weapons , armor and tools , as well as several other items, such as wings .

Unicorn Horn.name: Unicorn Horn
Unicorn Horn.tooltip: The Unicorn Horn is a Hardmode crafting material that is always dropped by Unicorns in The Hallow.

Dark Shard.name: Dark Shard
Dark Shard.tooltip: The Dark Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow and the Onyx Blaster.

Light Shard.name: Light Shard
Light Shard.tooltip: The Light Shard is a Hardmode crafting material used in the crafting of the Dao of Pow and the Sky Fracture.

Red Pressure Plate.name: Red Pressure Plate
Red Pressure Plate.tooltip: Pressure Plates are activation mechanisms that trigger wired mechanisms when stepped on. A pressure plate's color determines which characters can trigger it.

Wire.name: Wire
Wire.tooltip: Always buy more wire than you need!

Spell Tome.name: Spell Tome
Spell Tome.tooltip: The Spell Tome is a Hardmode crafting material used to create Crystal Storm, Cursed Flames, and Golden Shower.

Star Cloak.name: Star Cloak
Star Cloak.tooltip: The Star Cloak is a Hardmode accessory that causes three stars to fall around the player whenever the player takes damage.

Megashark.name: Megashark
Megashark.tooltip: The Megashark is a Hardmode gun and the direct upgrade to the Minishark.

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.tooltip: The Shotgun is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Arms Dealer for 25 GC.

Philosopher's Stone.name: Philosopher's Stone
Philosopher's Stone.tooltip: The Philosopher's Stone is a Hardmode accessory which decreases the Potion Sickness debuff duration by 25%.

Titan Glove.name: Titan Glove
Titan Glove.tooltip: The Titan Glove is a Hardmode accessory that doubles the knockback inflicted by melee weapons and increases their size by 10%.

Cobalt Naginata.name: Cobalt Naginata
Cobalt Naginata.tooltip: The Cobalt Naginata is a Hardmode spear.

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.tooltip: The Switch is an activation mechanism purchased from the Mechanic for 20 SC.

Dart Trap.name: Dart Trap
Dart Trap.tooltip: The Dart Trap is a trap that can be found naturally placed in Cavern layer and Dungeon.

Boulder.name: Boulder

Cursed Arrow.name: Cursed Arrow
Cursed Arrow.tooltip: The Cursed Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. It inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff for 7 seconds upon contact with enemies.

Soul of Might.name: Soul of Might

Soul of Sight.name: Soul of Sight
Soul of Sight.tooltip: The Soul of Sight is one of the six souls that can be obtained in Hardmode.

Gungnir.name: Gungnir
Gungnir.tooltip: The Gungnir is a Hardmode, post-one mechanical boss spear.

Hallowed Plate Mail.name: Hallowed Plate Mail
Hallowed Plate Mail.tooltip: Hallowed armor is a Hardmode , post- mechanical boss armor set consisting of the Hallowed Plate Mail and Hallowed Greaves , as well as four different headpieces: the Hallowed Mask , Hallowed Helmet , Hallowed Headgear , and Hallowed Hood , providing bonuses for melee, ranged, magic, and summon damage type respectively. Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Hallowed Bars . Crafting all six pieces requires a total of 90 Hallowed Bars.

Mana Flower.tooltip: The Mana Flower is a pre-Hardmode accessory that reduces mana usage by 8%, and enables auto-consumption of any mana-restoring potions in the player's inventory when mana is depleted.

Mechanical Worm.name: Mechanical Worm

Music Box (Overworld Day).name: Music Box (Overworld Day)
Music Box (Overworld Day).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Inlet Pump.name: Inlet Pump
Inlet Pump.tooltip: Inlet and Outlet Pumps are mechanisms used to transport liquids ( water , lava , honey , and shimmer (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) ), without having to construct pathways through blocks or rely on gravity. Instead, an Inlet and Outlet Pump need only be connected to each other with Wires and activated, which transfers fluid from the Inlet Pump to the Outlet Pump. Each activation transfers up to four tiles of liquid. For continuous automated pumping, a timer can be used.

Ebonwood Platform.name: Ebonwood Platform
Ebonwood Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Red's Wings.name: Red's Wings
Red's Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Lead Anvil.name: Lead Anvil

Most of their recipes require metal bars , although they are also used to make other items, such as the Jungle tier of equipment. An anvil is a vital crafting station for most of the game, as it is used to make items from every tier up to Cobalt and Palladium , after which it must be replaced by a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil .

Butterfly Wings.name: Butterfly Wings
Butterfly Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Flame Wings.name: Flame Wings
Flame Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Shadewood Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Shadewood Work Bench.name: Shadewood Work Bench
Shadewood Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Shadewood Table.name: Shadewood Table
Shadewood Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Shadewood Dresser.name: Shadewood Dresser
Shadewood Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Shadewood Piano.name: Shadewood Piano
Shadewood Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Shadewood Bed.name: Shadewood Bed
Shadewood Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Shadewood Sword.name: Shadewood Sword
Shadewood Sword.tooltip: The Shadewood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Shadewood Hammer.name: Shadewood Hammer
Shadewood Hammer.tooltip: The Shadewood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Shadewood Bow.name: Shadewood Bow
Shadewood Bow.tooltip: The Shadewood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Shadewood Helmet.name: Shadewood Helmet
Shadewood Helmet.tooltip: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet , Shadewood Breastplate , and Shadewood Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood . The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Breastplate.name: Shadewood Breastplate
Shadewood Breastplate.tooltip: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet , Shadewood Breastplate , and Shadewood Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood . The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Greaves.name: Shadewood Greaves
Shadewood Greaves.tooltip: Shadewood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Shadewood Helmet , Shadewood Breastplate , and Shadewood Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Shadewood . The full set grants 5 defense while equipped.

Shadewood Wall.name: Shadewood Wall
Shadewood Wall.tooltip: Shadewood Walls are a type of Wall made from Shadewood.

Cannon.name: Cannon
Cannon.tooltip: The Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon, purchased from the Pirate for 25 GC.

Cannonball.name: Cannonball
Cannonball.tooltip: The Cannonball is a type of ammunition used by the Cannon.

Flare Gun.name: Flare Gun
Flare Gun.tooltip: The Flare Gun is a weapon that provides a ranged method of illuminating areas.

Flare.name: Flare
Flare.tooltip: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun.

Bone Wand.name: Bone Wand
Bone Wand.tooltip: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana . Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below). There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 6 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 4 different block-placing wands.
Bone Wand.drops_summary: Angry Bones (0.4%), Cursed Skull (0.4%), Dark Caster (0.4%)

Leaf Wand.name: Leaf Wand
Leaf Wand.tooltip: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana . Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below). There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 6 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 4 different block-placing wands.
Leaf Wand.drops_summary: Angry Bones (0.4%), Cursed Skull (0.4%), Dark Caster (0.4%)

Flying Carpet.name: Flying Carpet
Flying Carpet.tooltip: The Flying Carpet is an accessory that allows the player to float for 5 seconds, similar to the Hoverboard.

Avenger Emblem.name: Avenger Emblem
Avenger Emblem.tooltip: The Avenger Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that grants 12% increased damage to all weapons.

Mechanical Glove.name: Mechanical Glove
Mechanical Glove.tooltip: The Mechanical Glove is a Hardmode accessory that is only available after defeating all three mechanical bosses.

Land Mine.name: Land Mine
Land Mine.tooltip: The Land Mine is a unique Hardmode, post-Plantera placeable item.

Paladin's Shield.name: Paladin's Shield
Paladin's Shield.tooltip: The Paladin's Shield is a Hardmode, post-Plantera shield accessory that functions primarily in multiplayer.

Web Slinger.name: Web Slinger
Web Slinger.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Jungle Water Fountain.name: Jungle Water Fountain
Jungle Water Fountain.tooltip: Water fountains are mechanisms that change the color of all nearby water . They can be activated via ⚷ Open / Activate or wire . There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 10 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 8 different obtainable fountains, all of which are purchased from the Witch Doctor for 4 GC each at any time. On the Old-gen console version and Nintendo 3DS versions , they are able to be purchased for free, but are only available after Plantera has been defeated. (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) The range of a Fountain is (when measured from the edges of the sprite) 60 tiles left, 53 tiles up, 60 tiles right, and 53 tiles down.
