Chlorophyte Ore.name: Chlorophyte Ore
Chlorophyte Ore.tooltip: Chlorophyte Ore is a Hardmode ore. When Hardmode starts, a portion of Mud Blocks located near Jungle grass blocks (naturally in the Underground Jungle) will be converted into Chlorophyte Ore.

Steampunk Wings.name: Steampunk Wings
Steampunk Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Snowball.name: Snowball
Snowball.tooltip: The Snowball is a consumable ranged weapon that can be crafted from Snow Blocks.

Ice Skates.name: Ice Skates
Ice Skates.tooltip: Ice Skates are a pre-Hardmode accessory that improves a player's movement control on Thin Ice, all Ice Blocks, Ice Rod blocks, Frozen Slime Blocks and Aetherium Blocks.
Ice Skates.drops_summary: Boreal Crate (16.67%), Frozen Chest (15.52%), Frozen Crate (16.67%)

Snowball Launcher.name: Snowball Launcher
Snowball Launcher.tooltip: The Snowball Launcher is a pre-Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon that has a 1/150 (0.67%) chance of being dropped by Snow Flinx.

Web Covered Chest.name: Web Covered Chest
Web Covered Chest.tooltip: Web Covered Chests can be found in Spider Nests, though they are rare.

Climbing Claws.name: Climbing Claws
Climbing Claws.tooltip: The Climbing Claws are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair.

Ancient Iron Helmet.name: Ancient Iron Helmet
Ancient Iron Helmet.tooltip: Iron armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Iron Helmet , Iron Chainmail , and Iron Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Iron Bars (180 Iron Ore ). The full set grants 9 defense while equipped.

Ancient Gold Helmet.name: Ancient Gold Helmet
Ancient Gold Helmet.tooltip: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet , Gold Chainmail , and Gold Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Gold Bars (300 Gold Ore ). The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

Ancient Shadow Helmet.name: Ancient Shadow Helmet
Ancient Shadow Helmet.tooltip: Ancient Shadow armor is an armor set that reproduces the pre- 1.0.3 Shadow armor design, and is otherwise identical in all ways to the current Shadow armor set. Each piece is interchangeable with the equivalent Shadow armor piece, while still granting the same set bonus.

Ancient Shadow Scalemail.name: Ancient Shadow Scalemail
Ancient Shadow Scalemail.tooltip: Ancient Shadow armor is an armor set that reproduces the pre- 1.0.3 Shadow armor design, and is otherwise identical in all ways to the current Shadow armor set. Each piece is interchangeable with the equivalent Shadow armor piece, while still granting the same set bonus.

Ancient Shadow Greaves.name: Ancient Shadow Greaves
Ancient Shadow Greaves.tooltip: Ancient Shadow armor is an armor set that reproduces the pre- 1.0.3 Shadow armor design, and is otherwise identical in all ways to the current Shadow armor set. Each piece is interchangeable with the equivalent Shadow armor piece, while still granting the same set bonus.

Ancient Necro Helmet.name: Ancient Necro Helmet
Ancient Necro Helmet.tooltip: Necro armor is a pre-Hardmode , post- Skeletron ranged armor set consisting of the Necro Helmet , Necro Breastplate , and Necro Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 135 Cobwebs and 150 Bones .

Ancient Cobalt Helmet.name: Ancient Cobalt Helmet
Ancient Cobalt Helmet.tooltip: Ancient Cobalt armor is an armor set obtained from Hornets and Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle . Each piece is dropped individually with a 1/300 (0.33%) chance.

Ancient Cobalt Breastplate.name: Ancient Cobalt Breastplate
Ancient Cobalt Breastplate.tooltip: Ancient Cobalt armor is an armor set obtained from Hornets and Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle . Each piece is dropped individually with a 1/300 (0.33%) chance.

Ancient Cobalt Leggings.name: Ancient Cobalt Leggings
Ancient Cobalt Leggings.tooltip: Ancient Cobalt armor is an armor set obtained from Hornets and Man Eaters in the Underground Jungle . Each piece is dropped individually with a 1/300 (0.33%) chance.

Black Belt.name: Black Belt
Black Belt.tooltip: The Black Belt is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that grants a 1/10 (10%) chance to dodge an attack, including instances of damage taken from hazards such as traps and lava.

Boomstick.name: Boomstick
Boomstick.tooltip: The Boomstick is a pre-Hardmode gun. It can be found in Ivy Chests (21.72% chance) in the Underground Jungle, and also in Jungle Crates(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) (19/100 (19%) chance).
Boomstick.drops_summary: Bramble Crate (19%), Ivy Chest (21.72%), Jungle Crate (19%)

Rope.name: Rope
Rope.tooltip: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility.

Campfire.name: Campfire
Campfire.tooltip: The Campfire is a placed furniture item that emits light and provides the Cozy Fire buff to players in its vicinity.

Marshmallow.name: Marshmallow
Marshmallow.tooltip: The Marshmallow is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Marshmallow on a Stick.name: Marshmallow on a Stick
Marshmallow on a Stick.tooltip: The Marshmallow on a Stick is an item that is used to create a Cooked Marshmallow by holding it over any lit Campfire, i.e.

Cooked Marshmallow.name: Cooked Marshmallow
Cooked Marshmallow.tooltip: The Cooked Marshmallow is a food item that grants the Well Fed buff when consumed.

Red Rocket.name: Red Rocket
Red Rocket.tooltip: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 SC each.

Green Rocket.name: Green Rocket
Green Rocket.tooltip: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 SC each.

Ice Torch.name: Ice Torch
Ice Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Shoe Spikes.name: Shoe Spikes
Shoe Spikes.tooltip: The Shoe Spikes are an accessory that lets players partially "stick" to the sides of blocks, slowly sliding down them when moving against them in midair.

Tiger Climbing Gear.name: Tiger Climbing Gear
Tiger Climbing Gear.tooltip: Tiger Climbing Gear is an accessory that allows for sliding down, and completely stopping while touching walls.

Tabi.name: Tabi
Tabi.tooltip: The Tabi is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory which allows the player to perform a dash by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key.

Pink Snow Hood.name: Pink Snow Hood
Pink Snow Hood.tooltip: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood , Pink Snow Coat , and Pink Snow Pants .

Pink Snow Coat.name: Pink Snow Coat
Pink Snow Coat.tooltip: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood , Pink Snow Coat , and Pink Snow Pants .

Pink Snow Pants.name: Pink Snow Pants
Pink Snow Pants.tooltip: Pink Snow armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pink Snow Hood , Pink Snow Coat , and Pink Snow Pants .

Pink Thread.name: Pink Thread
Pink Thread.tooltip: Threads are crafting materials used primarily in vanity items .

Mana Regeneration Band.name: Mana Regeneration Band
Mana Regeneration Band.tooltip: The Mana Regeneration Band is an accessory item made by combining a Band of Starpower and a Band of Regeneration at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Sandstorm in a Balloon.name: Sandstorm in a Balloon
Sandstorm in a Balloon.tooltip: The Sandstorm in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the functions of the Sandstorm in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.

Master Ninja Gear.name: Master Ninja Gear
Master Ninja Gear.tooltip: The Master Ninja Gear is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the abilities of the Black Belt, the Tabi, and the Tiger Climbing Gear.

Rope Coil.name: Rope Coil
Rope Coil.tooltip: Rope Coils are consumable mobility items that, when thrown by the player, travel in an arc affected by gravity until striking a block.

Blowgun.name: Blowgun
Blowgun.tooltip: The Blowgun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that can be purchased from the Witch Doctor for 5 GC.

Blizzard in a Bottle.name: Blizzard in a Bottle
Blizzard in a Bottle.tooltip: The Blizzard in a Bottle is a pre-Hardmode accessory which works similarly to the Cloud in a Bottle, allowing the player to double-jump.
Blizzard in a Bottle.drops_summary: Boreal Crate (16.67%), Frozen Chest (15.52%), Frozen Crate (16.67%)

Frostburn Arrow.name: Frostburn Arrow
Frostburn Arrow.tooltip: The Frostburn Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow. It has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 3 seconds on enemies.

Enchanted Sword.name: Enchanted Sword
Enchanted Sword.tooltip: The Enchanted Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword. When swung, it occasionally fires an Enchanted Beam projectile that cannot pierce enemies or pass through blocks.

Pickaxe Axe.name: Pickaxe Axe
Pickaxe Axe.tooltip: The Pickaxe Axe is a Hardmode, post-mechanical bosses pickaxe and axe.

Cobalt Waraxe.name: Cobalt Waraxe
Cobalt Waraxe.tooltip: The Cobalt Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Cobalt Chainsaw.

Mythril Waraxe.name: Mythril Waraxe
Mythril Waraxe.tooltip: The Mythril Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Mythril Chainsaw.

Adamantite Waraxe.name: Adamantite Waraxe
Adamantite Waraxe.tooltip: The Adamantite Waraxe is a Hardmode axe and the alternative to the Adamantite Chainsaw.

Eater's Bone.name: Eater's Bone
Eater's Bone.tooltip: The Eater's Bone is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Baby Eater that follows the player.
Eater's Bone.drops_summary: Eater of Worlds (5%), Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds) (5%)

Blend-O-Matic.name: Blend-O-Matic
Blend-O-Matic.tooltip: The Blend-O-Matic is a crafting station that is purchased from the Steampunker for 10 GC.

Meat Grinder.name: Meat Grinder
Meat Grinder.tooltip: The Meat Grinder is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Flesh Blocks and Lesion Blocks.

Extractinator.name: Extractinator
Extractinator.tooltip: The Extractinator (or Silt Extractinator) is a special crafting station that converts Silt, Slush, and Desert Fossils into various valuable materials such as ores, coins, and gems.
Extractinator.drops_summary: Frozen Chest (4.9%), Gold Chest (5%), Wooden Crate (1.86%)

Solidifier.name: Solidifier
Solidifier.tooltip: The Solidifier is a crafting station used to craft Slime furniture out of Slime Blocks, from which the Solidifier can also be used to craft.

Amber.name: Amber
Amber.tooltip: Amber is a gem. It can be obtained by placing Silt, Slush, or Desert Fossil into an Extractinator, or by searching through Underground Deserts.

Confetti Gun.name: Confetti Gun
Confetti Gun.tooltip: The Confetti Gun is a consumable novelty weapon that fires a cloud of colorful confetti, and inflicts no damage.

Chlorophyte Mask.name: Chlorophyte Mask
Chlorophyte Mask.tooltip: Chlorophyte armor is a Hardmode , post- mechanical bosses armor set consisting of the Chlorophyte Plate Mail and Chlorophyte Greaves , as well as three different headpieces: the Chlorophyte Mask , Chlorophyte Helmet , and Chlorophyte Headgear , providing bonuses for the melee, ranged, and magic damage type respectively. Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Chlorophyte Bars (270 Chlorophyte Ore ). Crafting all five pieces requires a total of 78 Chlorophyte Bars (390 Chlorophyte Ore).

Red Dye.name: Red Dye
Red Dye.tooltip: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor , vanity items , and accessories . The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes ( Silver Dye and Brown Dye ) as well as the Dye Vat ( 5 GC ). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes. There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 119 / (Old-gen console version) 68 different dyes in the game (118 / 67 on single-player worlds, as Team Dye is not available in single-player worlds). Some dyes will make sprites visible in complete darkness, most of which are Strange Dyes.

Paintbrush.name: Paintbrush
Paintbrush.tooltip: The Paintbrush is a tool which is used to apply paint to tiles.

Paint Roller.name: Paint Roller
Paint Roller.tooltip: The Paint Roller is a tool which is used to paint walls.

Red Paint.name: Red Paint
Red Paint.tooltip: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

Teal Mushroom.name: Teal Mushroom
Teal Mushroom.tooltip: The Teal Mushroom is a type of mushroom that grows in the Underground layer.

Green Mushroom.name: Green Mushroom

Sky Blue Flower.name: Sky Blue Flower
Sky Blue Flower.tooltip: The Sky Blue Flower is a type of plant that grows in the Jungle and Underground Jungle.

Yellow Marigold.name: Yellow Marigold
Yellow Marigold.tooltip: The Yellow Marigold is a type of plant that grows above-ground on grass in the Forest biome.

Blue Berries.name: Blue Berries
Blue Berries.tooltip: Blue Berries are a dye material that can be collected from any Grass block by destroying a blueberry bush with a Pickaxe or Drill.

Lime Kelp.name: Lime Kelp
Lime Kelp.tooltip: The Lime Kelp is a dye material and type of plant that is found under any liquid (most commonly underwater) in the Underground and Cavern layers.

Pink Prickly Pear.name: Pink Prickly Pear
Pink Prickly Pear.tooltip: The Pink Prickly Pear is a dye material which can grow on top of a regular or Hallowed Cactus, and can also be found on top of a Corrupted or Crimson Cactus.

Orange Bloodroot.name: Orange Bloodroot
Orange Bloodroot.tooltip: The Orange Bloodroot is a type of plant that grows from dirt ceilings in the underground and cavern layers.

Red Husk.name: Red Husk
Red Husk.tooltip: The Red Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cochineal Beetles.

Cyan Husk.name: Cyan Husk
Cyan Husk.tooltip: The Cyan Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Cyan Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Snow biome.

Violet Husk.name: Violet Husk
Violet Husk.tooltip: The Violet Husk is a dye material that is dropped by Lac Beetles, which only spawn in the Underground Jungle.

Purple Mucus.name: Purple Mucus
Purple Mucus.tooltip: The Purple Mucus is a dye material that is dropped by Sea Snails, which only spawn in the Ocean biome.

Black Ink.name: Black Ink

Dye Vat.name: Dye Vat
Dye Vat.tooltip: The Dye Vat is a crafting station used to craft Dyes and some Paints.

Bee Gun.name: Bee Gun
Bee Gun.tooltip: The Bee Gun is a pre-Hardmode magic gun that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee.

Possessed Hatchet.name: Possessed Hatchet
Possessed Hatchet.tooltip: The Possessed Hatchet is a Hardmode, post-Golem boomerang that has a 1/7 (14.29%) chance of being dropped from Golem.

Bee Keeper.name: Bee Keeper
Bee Keeper.tooltip: The Bee Keeper is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance of being dropped by the Queen Bee.

Hive.name: Hive
Hive.tooltip: Hive is a block type that Bee Hives are made from.

Honey Block.name: Honey Block
Honey Block.tooltip: Honey Blocks are blocks formed when water comes into contact with honey.

Hive Wall.name: Hive Wall
Hive Wall.tooltip: The Hive Wall is a type of background wall which can be found naturally generated in Bee Hives, considered unsafe.

Crispy Honey Block.name: Crispy Honey Block
Crispy Honey Block.tooltip: The Crispy Honey Block is a block formed when liquid honey comes into contact with lava.

Honey Bucket.name: Honey Bucket
Honey Bucket.tooltip: Buckets are tools used to carry water , lava , or honey , allowing them to be removed or placed. With an Empty Bucket , pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button on any sufficient body of liquid collects it, which replaces the Empty Bucket with the respective Water Bucket , Lava Bucket , or Honey Bucket . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button again will deposit the liquid at the location of the cursor, wherein the filled bucket is again replaced with an Empty Bucket. Each bucket holds one tile of liquid. Shimmer cannot be collected with standard buckets.

Hive Wand.name: Hive Wand
Hive Wand.tooltip: Block-placing wands are special tools that allow the player to place blocks they would normally not be able to place. They do not consume any mana . Each wand consumes a specific material from the player's inventory (details listed below). There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 6 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 4 different block-placing wands.
Hive Wand.drops_summary: Angry Bones (0.4%), Cursed Skull (0.4%), Dark Caster (0.4%)

Beenade.name: Beenade
Beenade.tooltip: The Beenade is a consumable ranged weapon that acts similarly to a regular Grenade when thrown but releases 15–24 friendly bee projectiles upon detonating after 3 seconds.

Gravity Globe.name: Gravity Globe
Gravity Globe.tooltip: The Gravity Globe is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord accessory that allows the holder to flip gravity, so that the player falls up instead of down, and toggle gravity back to normal afterward.

Honey Comb.name: Honey Comb
Honey Comb.tooltip: The Honey Comb is a pre-Hardmode accessory which, when equipped, spawns 1–3 (or 1–4 with a Hive Pack(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) equipped) bee projectiles which attack nearby enemies each time the player takes damage.

Abeemination.name: Abeemination
Abeemination.tooltip: The Abeemination is a boss-summoning item that summons the Queen Bee when used.

Bottled Honey.name: Bottled Honey
Bottled Honey.tooltip: Bottled Honey is a pre-Hardmode crafting material and recovery potion.

Rain Hat.name: Rain Hat
Rain Hat.tooltip: Rain armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rain Hat and Rain Coat . Each piece has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance to be dropped by Rain Coat Zombies . The full set grants 3 defense while equipped.

Rain Coat.name: Rain Coat
Rain Coat.tooltip: Rain armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Rain Hat and Rain Coat . Each piece has a 1/40 (2.5%) chance to be dropped by Rain Coat Zombies . The full set grants 3 defense while equipped.

Lihzahrd Door.name: Lihzahrd Door
Lihzahrd Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Temple Key.name: Temple Key

Lihzahrd Chest.name: Lihzahrd Chest
Lihzahrd Chest.tooltip: Lihzahrd Chests are chests found in the Jungle Temple.

Lihzahrd Chair.name: Lihzahrd Chair
Lihzahrd Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Lihzahrd Table.name: Lihzahrd Table
Lihzahrd Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Lihzahrd Work Bench.name: Lihzahrd Work Bench
Lihzahrd Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Super Dart Trap.name: Super Dart Trap
Super Dart Trap.tooltip: The Super Dart Trap is a trap found inside the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door.

Flame Trap.name: Flame Trap
Flame Trap.tooltip: The Flame Trap is a trap found naturally in the Jungle Temple.

Spiky Ball Trap.name: Spiky Ball Trap
Spiky Ball Trap.tooltip: The Spiky Ball Trap is a type of trap that can be found naturally in the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door.

Spear Trap.name: Spear Trap
Spear Trap.tooltip: The Spear Trap is a trap found naturally in the Jungle Temple and, rarely, outside the Temple's door.

Wooden Spike.name: Wooden Spike
Wooden Spike.tooltip: The Wooden Spike is a type of trap block that damages players who come in contact with it, and is the upgrade of the regular, metal Spike.

Lihzahrd Pressure Plate.name: Lihzahrd Pressure Plate
Lihzahrd Pressure Plate.tooltip: Pressure Plates are activation mechanisms that trigger wired mechanisms when stepped on. A pressure plate's color determines which characters can trigger it.

Lihzahrd Statue.name: Lihzahrd Statue
Lihzahrd Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Leaf Wings.name: Leaf Wings
Leaf Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Blizzard in a Balloon.name: Blizzard in a Balloon
Blizzard in a Balloon.tooltip: The Blizzard in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Blizzard in a Bottle and the Shiny Red Balloon.

Bundle of Balloons.name: Bundle of Balloons
Bundle of Balloons.tooltip: The Bundle of Balloons is an accessory that allows the wearer to perform a quadruple jump, as well as increasing the player's jump duration by 33% and jump speed by 30%.

Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 59 Titanium Bars (236 Titanium Ore ). Crafting all five pieces requires a total of 85 Titanium Bars (340 Titanium Ore).

Orichalcum Anvil.name: Orichalcum Anvil
Orichalcum Anvil.tooltip: The Mythril Anvil and Orichalcum Anvil are Hardmode crafting stations that serve and extend the function of a pre-Hardmode Anvil . These are very crucial to game advancement, as they account for making nearly every Hardmode recipe before the Ancient Manipulator (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . In addition to acting as a direct replacement to Lead and Iron Anvils and inheriting all of their crafting recipes, they further serve the similar function of crafting bars forged of Hardmode ores into weapons , armor and tools , as well as several other items, such as wings .

Titanium Forge.name: Titanium Forge
Titanium Forge.tooltip: The Adamantite Forge and Titanium Forge are Hardmode crafting stations that incorporate the same functions as a regular Furnace and Hellforge , with the additional bonus of being able to smelt Adamantite , Titanium and Chlorophyte ores into their respective bars . They give off fire particles like the Furnace and Hellforge.

Amethyst Hook.name: Amethyst Hook
Amethyst Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Orange Torch.name: Orange Torch
Orange Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Crimsand Block.name: Crimsand Block
Crimsand Block.tooltip: Sand Blocks are soil blocks found in vast quantities in Desert biomes , at shore and bottom of Ocean biomes, and can be found as microbiomes in patches in the Underground layer. They are also shot as projectiles by Antlions . Sand can spread and be converted by the evil biomes and The Hallow (see below ).

Ichor Arrow.name: Ichor Arrow
Ichor Arrow.tooltip: The Ichor Arrow is a Hardmode arrow. It inflicts the Ichor debuff for 10 seconds upon contact with enemies.

Ichor Bullet.name: Ichor Bullet
Ichor Bullet.tooltip: The Ichor Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It inflicts the Ichor debuff on hit for 10 seconds (15 seconds in PvP), decreasing the enemy's defense by 15.

Golden Shower.name: Golden Shower
Golden Shower.tooltip: The Golden Shower is a Hardmode spell book that fires arcing golden ichor streams in quick succession.

Bunny Cannon.name: Bunny Cannon
Bunny Cannon.tooltip: The Bunny Cannon is a Hardmode placeable furniture/weapon.

Explosive Bunny.name: Explosive Bunny
Explosive Bunny.tooltip: The Explosive Bunny is an item that serves as ammunition for the Bunny Cannon.

Vial of Venom.name: Vial of Venom
Vial of Venom.tooltip: The Vial of Venom is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Witch Doctor for 15 SC each, after Plantera has been defeated.

Flask of Venom.name: Flask of Venom
Flask of Venom.tooltip: The Flask of Venom is a Hardmode, post-Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Acid Venom debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit.

Venom Arrow.name: Venom Arrow
Venom Arrow.tooltip: The Venom Arrow is a Hardmode, post-Plantera arrow.

Venom Bullet.name: Venom Bullet
Venom Bullet.tooltip: The Venom Bullet is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bullet.

Fire Gauntlet.name: Fire Gauntlet
Fire Gauntlet.tooltip: The Fire Gauntlet is a Hardmode accessory available after defeating all three mechanical bosses that combines the effect of the Mechanical Glove and the Magma Stone.

Cog.name: Cog
Cog.tooltip: Cogs are Hardmode crafting materials and placeable blocks that are purchased from the Steampunker for 7 SC each.

Confetti.name: Confetti
Confetti.tooltip: Confetti is a crafting material used to make several festive items.

Nanites.name: Nanites
Nanites.tooltip: Nanites are a Hardmode crafting material used solely for crafting the Flask of Nanites and Nano Bullets, whose purpose is to inflict the Confused debuff with melee and ranged weapons, respectively.

Explosive Powder.name: Explosive Powder
Explosive Powder.tooltip: Explosive Powder is a Hardmode crafting material purchased from the Demolitionist for 12 SC each, once the Wall of Flesh has been defeated.

Gold Dust.name: Gold Dust
Gold Dust.tooltip: Gold Dust is a Hardmode crafting material that is purchased from the Merchant for 17 SC each.

Party Bullet.name: Party Bullet
Party Bullet.tooltip: The Party Bullet is a pre-Hardmode bullet. It releases a visual cloud of confetti upon contact with enemies or blocks.

Nano Bullet.name: Nano Bullet
Nano Bullet.tooltip: The Nano Bullet is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bullet.

Exploding Bullet.name: Exploding Bullet
Exploding Bullet.tooltip: The Exploding Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It explodes on impact with enemies or blocks, dealing damage and knockback within an area.

Golden Bullet.name: Golden Bullet
Golden Bullet.tooltip: The Golden Bullet is a Hardmode bullet. It inflicts the Midas debuff on hit for 2 seconds, causing enemies to drop 10%-50% more coins when killed.

Flask of Cursed Flames.name: Flask of Cursed Flames

Flask of Fire.name: Flask of Fire
Flask of Fire.tooltip: The Flask of Fire is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the On Fire!

Flask of Gold.name: Flask of Gold
Flask of Gold.tooltip: The Flask of Gold is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Midas debuff for 2 seconds on enemies hit.

Flask of Ichor.name: Flask of Ichor
Flask of Ichor.tooltip: The Flask of Ichor is a Hardmode flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Ichor debuff for 10–19 seconds on enemies hit.

Flask of Nanites.name: Flask of Nanites
Flask of Nanites.tooltip: The Flask of Nanites is a Hardmode, post-Plantera flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Confused debuff for 1–3 seconds on enemies hit.

Flask of Party.name: Flask of Party
Flask of Party.tooltip: The Flask of Party is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to create bursts of confetti when hitting enemies.

Flask of Poison.name: Flask of Poison
Flask of Poison.tooltip: The Flask of Poison is a flask that causes melee weapons and whips(Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) to inflict the Poisoned debuff for 5–9 seconds on enemies hit.

Blue Brick Platform.name: Blue Brick Platform
Blue Brick Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Blue Dungeon Chair.name: Blue Dungeon Chair
Blue Dungeon Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Blue Dungeon Table.name: Blue Dungeon Table
Blue Dungeon Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Blue Dungeon Work Bench.name: Blue Dungeon Work Bench
Blue Dungeon Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

Shadowbeam Staff.name: Shadowbeam Staff
Shadowbeam Staff.tooltip: The Shadowbeam Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Necromancers in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Inferno Fork.name: Inferno Fork
Inferno Fork.tooltip: The Inferno Fork is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Diabolists in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Spectre Staff.name: Spectre Staff
Spectre Staff.tooltip: The Spectre Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that has a 1/20 (5%) / 39/400 (9.75%) chance of being dropped by Ragged Casters in the Hardmode Dungeon.

Wooden Fence.name: Wooden Fence
Wooden Fence.tooltip: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences.

Bubble Machine.tooltip: The Bubble Machine is a novelty furniture mechanism purchased from the Party Girl for 4 GC (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) during the day / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) at any time.

Bubble Wand.name: Bubble Wand
Bubble Wand.tooltip: The Bubble Wand is an auto-swing novelty item that produces rainbow-colored bubbles.

Marching Bones Banner.name: Marching Bones Banner
Marching Bones Banner.tooltip: Banners are decorative furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks . Many are found naturally-placed in various biomes . There are also four crafted banners (Red, Green, Blue, and Yellow). Banners can be hung off of blocks and off of platforms which are in (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) any position / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) their bottom position (after being struck three times with a hammer ).

Obsidian Platform.name: Obsidian Platform
Obsidian Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Obsidian Door.name: Obsidian Door
Obsidian Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Obsidian Chair.name: Obsidian Chair
Obsidian Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Obsidian Table.name: Obsidian Table
Obsidian Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Obsidian Work Bench.name: Obsidian Work Bench
Obsidian Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Obsidian Vase.name: Obsidian Vase
Obsidian Vase.tooltip: Vases are non- craftable furniture items. They can be found either in the Dungeon or the Underworld and can be mined with any pickaxe or drill .

Obsidian Bookcase.name: Obsidian Bookcase
Obsidian Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Blue Dungeon Bed.name: Blue Dungeon Bed
Blue Dungeon Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Crafting a full set with one headpiece requires a total of 54 Spectre Bars (27 Ectoplasm and 270 Chlorophyte Ore ). Gothic Chair.name: Gothic Chair
Gothic Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Gothic Table.name: Gothic Table
Gothic Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Gothic Work Bench.name: Gothic Work Bench
Gothic Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Gothic Bookcase.name: Gothic Bookcase
Gothic Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Paladin's Hammer.name: Paladin's Hammer
Paladin's Hammer.tooltip: The Paladin's Hammer is a Hardmode, post-Plantera boomerang that has a 1/15 (6.67%) / 29/225 (12.89%) chance of being dropped by Paladins in the Hardmode Dungeon.

SWAT Helmet.name: SWAT Helmet
SWAT Helmet.tooltip: The SWAT Helmet is a vanity item that has a 1/12 (8.33%) / 23/144 (15.97%) chance to drop from Tactical Skeletons in the post-Plantera Dungeon.

Bee Wings.name: Bee Wings
Bee Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Bone Feather.name: Bone Feather

Large Amethyst.name: Large Amethyst
Large Amethyst.tooltip: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem , and are dropped when the player dies , even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode . With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head. If two or more different Large Gems are carried, their holograms will revolve in a circular pattern above the player's head. They are immediately deleted if placed in a player's trash slot [ 1 ] .

D-Town's Wings.name: D-Town's Wings
D-Town's Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Music Box (Snow).name: Music Box (Snow)
Music Box (Snow).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Blue Flare.name: Blue Flare
Blue Flare.tooltip: Flares are a type of ammunition used solely by the Flare Gun . Flares fired from the Flare Gun travel in a slight arc and stick to blocks (similar to Sticky Glowsticks ), but have greater velocity and range. They are waterproof, can be fired into and out of water , and emit low-level, flickering, tinted light that lasts for 10 minutes. They stick to the blocks they impacted and will function underwater. Flares cannot be recovered once they burn out.

Glass Platform.name: Glass Platform
Glass Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Glass Chair.name: Glass Chair
Glass Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Golden Chair.name: Golden Chair
Golden Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Golden Toilet.name: Golden Toilet
Golden Toilet.tooltip: Toilets are furniture items which can be placed on the ground. They are functionally similar to chairs , and count as comfort items for NPC house requirements. In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations. Only the Toilet and Golden Toilet are considered as a valid crafting station .

Glass Door.name: Glass Door
Glass Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Glass Bed.name: Glass Bed
Glass Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Pumpkin Helmet.name: Pumpkin Helmet
Pumpkin Helmet.tooltip: Pumpkin armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Pumpkin Helmet , Pumpkin Breastplate , and Pumpkin Leggings . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Pumpkins . The full set grants 7 defense and increases all damage dealt by the player by 10% while equipped.

Candy Apple.name: Candy Apple
Candy Apple.tooltip: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas ) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies , broken pots , or as a bonus drop from slimes . Enemies and pots will only drop Hearts when the closest player does not have full health . They are not inventory items , but are instead instantly consumed and restore 20 health. They emit a faint red light.

Soul Cake.name: Soul Cake
Soul Cake.tooltip: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas ) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24 (54.17%) , as long as the player is below maximum mana . They are not inventory items , but are instead instantly consumed and restore 100 mana. Enemies will only drop Stars if the closest player is not at maximum mana.

Candy Corn Rifle.name: Candy Corn Rifle
Candy Corn Rifle.tooltip: The Candy Corn Rifle is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that consumes Candy Corn as ammunition.

Candy Corn.name: Candy Corn
Candy Corn.tooltip: The Candy Corn Rifle is a Hardmode , post- Plantera gun that consumes Candy Corn as ammunition . When used, it rapidly fires Candy Corn shots that pierce up to two enemies and ricochet up to four times, dissipating on their fifth impact or upon hitting a third enemy. The projectiles are affected by gravity. The Candy Corn Rifle also has a base 10% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%, and has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance not to consume ammo .

Jack 'O Lantern Launcher.name: Jack 'O Lantern Launcher
Jack 'O Lantern Launcher.tooltip: The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera launcher that consumes Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns as ammunition.

Explosive Jack 'O Lantern.name: Explosive Jack 'O Lantern
Explosive Jack 'O Lantern.tooltip: The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher is a Hardmode , post- Plantera launcher that consumes Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns as ammunition . Explosive Jack 'O Lanterns bounce off blocks before exploding upon contact with an enemy or after 5 seconds. The Jack 'O Lantern Launcher has a base 10% critical strike chance as opposed to the usual 4%.

Sickle.name: Sickle
Sickle.tooltip: The Sickle is a tool that produces Hay blocks when used to cut wild grass plants and sea oats.

Pumpkin Pie.name: Pumpkin Pie
Pumpkin Pie.tooltip: The Pumpkin Pie is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.

Scarecrow Hat.name: Scarecrow Hat
Scarecrow Hat.tooltip: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat , the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants . All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event , each with a 0.37%–3.33% ( 0.56%–3.33% ) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ]

Scarecrow Shirt.name: Scarecrow Shirt
Scarecrow Shirt.tooltip: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat , the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants . All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event , each with a 0.37%–3.33% ( 0.56%–3.33% ) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ]

Scarecrow Pants.name: Scarecrow Pants
Scarecrow Pants.tooltip: The Scarecrow set is a vanity set which consists of the Scarecrow Hat , the Scarecrow Shirt and the Scarecrow Pants . All three parts of the set are dropped by Scarecrows during the Pumpkin Moon event , each with a 0.37%–3.33% ( 0.56%–3.33% ) chance depending on the current wave. [ 1 ]

Cauldron.name: Cauldron
Cauldron.tooltip: The Cooking Pot is a crafting station that is solely used to turn various items into food, consumables that induce the Well Fed , Plenty Satisfied and Exquisitely Stuffed buffs . Such food material include the Bowl of Soup , Cooked Fish , Cooked Shrimp , and Grub Soup .

Pumpkin Chair.name: Pumpkin Chair
Pumpkin Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Pumpkin Door.name: Pumpkin Door
Pumpkin Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Pumpkin Table.name: Pumpkin Table
Pumpkin Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Pumpkin Work Bench.name: Pumpkin Work Bench
Pumpkin Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Pumpkin Platform.name: Pumpkin Platform
Pumpkin Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Tattered Fairy Wings.name: Tattered Fairy Wings
Tattered Fairy Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Spider Egg.name: Spider Egg
Spider Egg.tooltip: The Spider Egg is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Pet Spider to follow the player around.

Magical Pumpkin Seed.name: Magical Pumpkin Seed
Magical Pumpkin Seed.tooltip: The Magical Pumpkin Seed is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Squashling that follows the player.

Bat Hook.name: Bat Hook
Bat Hook.tooltip: The Bat Hook is a rare pre-Hardmode grappling hook that fires a single hook which reaches 31.25 tiles at maximum length, and has the longest reach of all pre-Hardmode hooks.

Bat Scepter.name: Bat Scepter
Bat Scepter.tooltip: The Bat Scepter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Raven Staff.name: Raven Staff
Raven Staff.tooltip: The Raven Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Raven minion.

Jungle Key Mold.name: Jungle Key Mold
Jungle Key Mold.tooltip: Biome Key Molds are extremely rare Hardmode crafting materials that are used to craft Biome Keys , which open Biome Chests once Plantera is defeated. After the Wall of Flesh is defeated, every enemy killed within an eligible biome has a 1/2500 (0.04%) chance of dropping a Biome Key Mold, with the exception of Meteor Heads and statue -spawned enemies. The type of key mold that is dropped depends on the biome the player is currently in ( Jungle , Corruption , Crimson , Hallow , or Snow ).

Hanging Jack 'O Lantern.name: Hanging Jack 'O Lantern
Hanging Jack 'O Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Rotten Egg.name: Rotten Egg
Rotten Egg.tooltip: The Rotten Egg is a consumable ranged weapon obtained commonly from Goodie Bags, which are dropped during the Halloween season, and from shaking trees during that time.
Rotten Egg.drops_summary: Ash tree (2.449%), Boreal tree (2.449%), Ebonwood Palm tree (2.8571%), +10 more

Unlucky Yarn.name: Unlucky Yarn
Unlucky Yarn.tooltip: The Unlucky Yarn is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Black Cat that follows the player.

Black Fairy Dust.name: Black Fairy Dust
Black Fairy Dust.tooltip: Black Fairy Dust is a crafting material used solely to craft Tattered Fairy Wings.

Jackelier.name: Jackelier
Jackelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Jack 'O Lantern.tooltip: The Jack 'O Lantern is a placeable furniture item that gives off light.

Bloody Machete.tooltip: The Bloody Machete is a pre-Hardmode boomerang that has a 1/2000 (0.05%) chance of being dropped by any weak enemy during the Halloween seasonal event.

The Horseman's Blade.name: The Horseman's Blade
The Horseman's Blade.tooltip: The Horseman's Blade is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that can be dropped by the Pumpking during the Pumpkin Moon event with a 2.5–12.5% (6.25–12.5%) chance depending on the current wave.

Bladed Glove.name: Bladed Glove

Pumpkin Seed.name: Pumpkin Seed
Pumpkin Seed.tooltip: The Pumpkin Seed is a seed which is used to plant Pumpkins.

Spooky Hook.name: Spooky Hook
Spooky Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Spooky Twig.name: Spooky Twig
Spooky Twig.tooltip: The Spooky Twig is a Hardmode, post-Plantera crafting material used solely for crafting Spooky Wings.

Spooky Helmet.name: Spooky Helmet
Spooky Helmet.tooltip: Spooky armor is a Hardmode , post- Plantera summoner armor set consisting of the Spooky Helmet , Spooky Breastplate , and Spooky Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 750 Spooky Wood .

Spooky Breastplate.name: Spooky Breastplate

Stake Launcher.tooltip: The Stake Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Plantera repeater that consumes Stakes as ammunition.

Stake.name: Stake
Stake.tooltip: The Stake Launcher is a Hardmode , post- Plantera repeater that consumes Stakes as ammunition . When used, it fires Stakes that pierce nine enemies , are unaffected by gravity, and have a higher velocity than most arrows . The Stake Launcher applies a 10% damage penalty to the next hit for each enemy pierced. The Stake Launcher has a base 14% critical strike chance , as opposed to the usual 4%.

Cursed Sapling.name: Cursed Sapling
Cursed Sapling.tooltip: The Cursed Sapling is a Hardmode, post-Plantera pet-summoning item that spawns a Cursed Sapling that follows the player.

Space Creature Mask.name: Space Creature Mask

Pumpkin Moon Medallion.name: Pumpkin Moon Medallion
Pumpkin Moon Medallion.tooltip: The Pumpkin Moon Medallion is a Hardmode, post-Plantera event-summoning item used to summon the Pumpkin Moon event.

Necromantic Scroll.name: Necromantic Scroll
Necromantic Scroll.tooltip: The Necromantic Scroll is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that increases the player's maximum number of minions by one and increases the damage of all summon weapons by 10%.

Jacking Skeletron.name: Jacking Skeletron
Jacking Skeletron.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

In total, there are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 33 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 24 trophies.

Sniper Scope.name: Sniper Scope

Heart Lantern.name: Heart Lantern
Heart Lantern.tooltip: The Heart Lantern is a functional lantern that grants the Heart Lamp buff, providing a health regeneration of 1 HP per second to all players within a rectangular area of 170×125 ( ) / 100×84 ( ) tiles.

Jellyfish Diving Gear.name: Jellyfish Diving Gear
Jellyfish Diving Gear.tooltip: Jellyfish Diving Gear is an accessory crafted by combining Jellyfish Necklace and Diving Gear at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Arctic Diving Gear.name: Arctic Diving Gear
Arctic Diving Gear.tooltip: The Arctic Diving Gear is an accessory which is crafted by combining the Jellyfish Diving Gear and Ice Skates at a Tinkerer's Workshop.

Frostspark Boots.name: Frostspark Boots
Frostspark Boots.tooltip: The Frostspark Boots are a pre-Hardmode accessory crafted from Lightning Boots and Ice Skates, and combines their functionality.

Fart in a Balloon.name: Fart in a Balloon
Fart in a Balloon.tooltip: The Fart in a Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Fart in a Jar and the Shiny Red Balloon.

Papyrus Scarab.name: Papyrus Scarab
Papyrus Scarab.tooltip: The Papyrus Scarab is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that combines the bonuses of the Necromantic Scroll and the Hercules Beetle.

Celestial Stone.name: Celestial Stone
Celestial Stone.tooltip: The Celestial Stone is a Hardmode post-Golem accessory crafted from a Moon Stone and a Sun Stone at the Tinkerer's Workshop.

Hoverboard.name: Hoverboard
Hoverboard.tooltip: The Hoverboard is a Hardmode wing-type accessory that allows the player to fly and glide, as all wings do.

Candy Cane.name: Candy Cane
Candy Cane.tooltip: Hearts (or Candy Apples during Halloween and Candy Canes during Christmas ) are common power-ups which can be dropped by slain enemies , broken pots , or as a bonus drop from slimes . Enemies and pots will only drop Hearts when the closest player does not have full health . They are not inventory items , but are instead instantly consumed and restore 20 health. They emit a faint red light.

Sugar Plum.name: Sugar Plum
Sugar Plum.tooltip: Stars (or Soul Cakes during Halloween and Sugar Plums during Christmas ) are common power-ups which can be dropped by any enemy with a chance of 13/24 (54.17%) , as long as the player is below maximum mana . They are not inventory items , but are instead instantly consumed and restore 100 mana. Enemies will only drop Stars if the closest player is not at maximum mana.

Present.name: Present
Present.tooltip: The Present is a grab bag item available during the Christmas seasonal event which contains a random Christmas-themed reward.

Red Ryder.name: Red Ryder
Red Ryder.tooltip: The Red Ryder is a pre-Hardmode gun dropped from Presents obtained during Christmas, with a 0.643% chance in pre-Hardmode and 0.6% chance in Hardmode.

Festive Wings.name: Festive Wings
Festive Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Giant Bow.name: Giant Bow
Giant Bow.tooltip: The Giant Bow is a festive vanity item that has a 1/20 (5%) chance to drop during Christmas by Present Slimes, which visually have a large bow on.

Reindeer Antlers.name: Reindeer Antlers
Reindeer Antlers.tooltip: The Reindeer Antlers are a vanity item that is dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 2.308% in pre-Hardmode and 2.154% in Hardmode.

Holly.name: Holly
Holly.tooltip: The Holly is a decorative item resembling an Advent wreath, a typical Christmas ornament.

Candy Cane Sword.name: Candy Cane Sword
Candy Cane Sword.tooltip: The Candy Cane Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 0.639% (pre-Hardmode) / 0.596% (Hardmode) chance to be obtained from Presents dropped during the Christmas event.

Elf Melter.name: Elf Melter
Elf Melter.tooltip: The Elf Melter is a Hardmode, post-Plantera ranged weapon that uses Gel for ammunition.

Christmas Pudding.name: Christmas Pudding
Christmas Pudding.tooltip: Christmas Pudding is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed.

Eggnog.name: Eggnog
Eggnog.tooltip: Eggnog is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 8.101% in pre-Hardmode and 7.561% in Hardmode.

Star Anise.name: Star Anise
Star Anise.tooltip: The Star Anise is a consumable ranged weapon, similar to Shurikens although slightly stronger.

Reindeer Bells.name: Reindeer Bells
Reindeer Bells.tooltip: The Reindeer Bells are a Hardmode, post-Plantera mount-summoning item that summons the rideable Rudolph mount, which greatly speeds a player's movement and adds the ability to fly.

Candy Cane Hook.name: Candy Cane Hook
Candy Cane Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Christmas Hook.name: Christmas Hook
Christmas Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. Candy Cane Pickaxe.name: Candy Cane Pickaxe
Candy Cane Pickaxe.tooltip: The Candy Cane Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian.

Fruitcake Chakram.name: Fruitcake Chakram
Fruitcake Chakram.tooltip: The Fruitcake Chakram is a pre-Hardmode boomerang dropped from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.626% in pre-Hardmode and 0.584% in Hardmode.

Sugar Cookie.name: Sugar Cookie
Sugar Cookie.tooltip: The Sugar Cookie is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed.

Gingerbread Cookie.name: Gingerbread Cookie
Gingerbread Cookie.tooltip: The Gingerbread Cookie is a food item that grants the Exquisitely Stuffed buff when consumed.

Hand Warmer.name: Hand Warmer
Hand Warmer.tooltip: The Hand Warmer is a pre-Hardmode immunity accessory that grants the player immunity to the Chilled and Frozen debuffs.

Coal.name: Coal
Coal.tooltip: Coal is an item with no use. It can drop from Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 1/30 (3.33%) in pre-Hardmode and 7/225 (3.11%) in Hardmode.

Toolbox.name: Toolbox
Toolbox.tooltip: The Toolbox is a rare accessory that is obtained when opening Presents dropped during the Christmas seasonal event, with a chance of 0.309% in pre-Hardmode and 0.288% in Hardmode.

Pine Door.name: Pine Door
Pine Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Pine Chair.name: Pine Chair
Pine Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Pine Table.name: Pine Table
Pine Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Dog Whistle.name: Dog Whistle
Dog Whistle.tooltip: The Dog Whistle is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Puppy that follows the player.

Christmas Tree Sword.name: Christmas Tree Sword
Christmas Tree Sword.tooltip: The Christmas Tree Sword is a Hardmode, post-Plantera broadsword that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

Chain Gun.name: Chain Gun
Chain Gun.tooltip: The Chain Gun is a Hardmode, post-Plantera gun that is dropped by Santa-NK1 during the Frost Moon event with a 6.25%–16.67% / 12.5%–50% chance depending on the current wave.

Razorpine.name: Razorpine
Razorpine.tooltip: The Razorpine is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped by the Everscream during the Frost Moon event with a 3.46%–10.37% (6.22%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

Blizzard Staff.name: Blizzard Staff
Blizzard Staff.tooltip: The Blizzard Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera wand that is dropped from the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon event with a 5.19%–10.37% (15.56%–31.11%) chance depending on the current wave.

Mrs. Claus Hat.name: Mrs. Claus Hat

It consists of a Mrs. Claus Hat , Mrs. Claus Shirt and Mrs. Claus Heels . These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.

Tree Mask.name: Tree Mask

As such, they can be placed and used to prevent enemies from spawning, and can be used to fulfill the requirements of a house .

Music Box (Pumpkin Moon).name: Music Box (Pumpkin Moon)
Music Box (Pumpkin Moon).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Cactus Bed.name: Cactus Bed
Cactus Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Ebonwood Fence.name: Ebonwood Fence

Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences.

Celestial Emblem.name: Celestial Emblem
Celestial Emblem.tooltip: The Celestial Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that offers 15% increased magic damage and a 18.75-tile increased pickup range for Stars (21.375 tile total range).

Celestial Cuffs.name: Celestial Cuffs
Celestial Cuffs.tooltip: The Celestial Cuffs are a pre-Hardmode accessory which restores mana when the wearer is damaged and increases pickup range for Stars.

Peddler's Hat.name: Peddler's Hat
Peddler's Hat.tooltip: The Peddler's Hat is a vanity item that always drops from the Traveling Merchant if he is killed.

Pulse Bow.name: Pulse Bow
Pulse Bow.tooltip: The Pulse Bow is a Hardmode bow that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 45 GC after defeating all three mechanical bosses.

Large Dynasty Lantern.name: Large Dynasty Lantern
Large Dynasty Lantern.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Dynasty Lamp.name: Dynasty Lamp
Dynasty Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Dynasty Lantern.name: Dynasty Lantern
Dynasty Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Large Dynasty Candle.name: Large Dynasty Candle
Large Dynasty Candle.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Dynasty Chair.name: Dynasty Chair
Dynasty Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Dynasty Work Bench.name: Dynasty Work Bench
Dynasty Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Dynasty Chest.name: Dynasty Chest
Dynasty Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Dynasty Bed.name: Dynasty Bed
Dynasty Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Dynasty Bathtub.name: Dynasty Bathtub
Dynasty Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Dynasty Bookcase.name: Dynasty Bookcase
Dynasty Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Dynasty Cup.name: Dynasty Cup
Dynasty Cup.tooltip: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table , Work Bench , or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations .

Dynasty Bowl.name: Dynasty Bowl
Dynasty Bowl.tooltip: Bowls are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed. Unlike plates , food cannot be placed in bowls. Only the regular Bowl can be used in crafting.

Dynasty Candle.name: Dynasty Candle
Dynasty Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Dynasty Clock.name: Dynasty Clock
Dynasty Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.
