Honey Cup.name: Honey Cup
Honey Cup.tooltip: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table , Work Bench , or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations .

Chalice.name: Chalice
Chalice.tooltip: Cups are a type of decorative furniture that can be placed on a table , Work Bench , or other flat furniture item. Once placed, all cups function as Placed Bottle crafting stations .

Dynasty Table.name: Dynasty Table
Dynasty Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Dynasty Wood.name: Dynasty Wood
Dynasty Wood.tooltip: Dynasty Wood is a type of wood purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 CC per block.

Red Dynasty Shingles.name: Red Dynasty Shingles
Red Dynasty Shingles.tooltip: Dynasty Shingles are blocks purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 CC apiece, and are only sold when the Traveling Merchant is also selling Dynasty Wood . They cannot be crafted into any background walls .

Blue Dynasty Shingles.name: Blue Dynasty Shingles
Blue Dynasty Shingles.tooltip: Dynasty Shingles are blocks purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 CC apiece, and are only sold when the Traveling Merchant is also selling Dynasty Wood . They cannot be crafted into any background walls .

White Dynasty Wall.name: White Dynasty Wall
White Dynasty Wall.tooltip: White Dynasty Wall and Blue Dynasty Wall are background walls crafted from Dynasty Wood , which is sold by the Traveling Merchant .

Blue Dynasty Wall.name: Blue Dynasty Wall
Blue Dynasty Wall.tooltip: White Dynasty Wall and Blue Dynasty Wall are background walls crafted from Dynasty Wood , which is sold by the Traveling Merchant .

Dynasty Door.name: Dynasty Door
Dynasty Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Sake.name: Sake
Sake.tooltip: Sake is a potion that grants the Tipsy debuff when consumed, which increases many of the player's stats but lowers the player's defense for four minutes, twice the duration of Ale.

Pad Thai.name: Pad Thai
Pad Thai.tooltip: Pad Thai is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff when consumed.

Pho.name: Pho
Pho.tooltip: Pho is a food item that grants the Plenty Satisfied buff.

Revolver.name: Revolver
Revolver.tooltip: The Revolver is a pre-Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC after a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart has been smashed.

Gatligator.name: Gatligator
Gatligator.tooltip: The Gatligator is a Hardmode gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 35 GC.

Arcane Rune Wall.name: Arcane Rune Wall
Arcane Rune Wall.tooltip: Arcane Rune Wall is a background wall that is purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 2 SC50 CC each.

Water Gun.name: Water Gun
Water Gun.tooltip: The Water Gun is a novelty item that sprays a stream of water which inflicts the Wet debuff on players, enemies, and NPCs for 30 seconds.

Katana.name: Katana
Katana.tooltip: The Katana is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC.

Ultrabright Torch.name: Ultrabright Torch
Ultrabright Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Magic Hat.name: Magic Hat
Magic Hat.tooltip: The Magic Hat is a pre-Hardmode armor piece that can be equipped in the helmet slot.

Diamond Ring.name: Diamond Ring
Diamond Ring.tooltip: The Diamond Ring is a vanity accessory. When worn, it places a blue dot on each of the player's wrists.

Gi.name: Gi
Gi.tooltip: The Gi is an armor item that can be equipped in the shirt slot.

Kimono.name: Kimono
Kimono.tooltip: The Kimono is a vanity item purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 1 GC.

Mystic Robe.name: Mystic Robe
Mystic Robe.tooltip: The Mystic Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot.

Beetle Wings.name: Beetle Wings
Beetle Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Iron Fence.name: Iron Fence
Iron Fence.tooltip: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences.

Old Shoe.name: Old Shoe
Old Shoe.tooltip: Fishing is an activity accomplished by using a fishing pole at a body of liquid ( water , honey , or lava ) while having bait in the player's inventory . Pressing the ⚒ Use / Attack button will cast a fishing line along with the bobber, which only functions when the bobber is thrown into liquid. Pressing the button again when the bobber moves up and down will reel in the line and often an item will come up with the line. The Angler NPC provides daily fishing quests and rewards their completion with an assortment of equipment, coins, potions, and vanity items.

Fish Hook.name: Fish Hook

A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Blue Jellyfish.name: Blue Jellyfish
Blue Jellyfish.tooltip: Jellyfish are enemies found in water . When underwater, they attack by propelling themselves towards the player in short bursts. When outside of water, they will be unable to move or pursue the player in any way. Jellyfish are able to jump out of the water to attack players, often leaving them stranded on land. Most varieties of Jellyfish produce light, making them easy to spot in dark areas. There are 5 Jellyfish variants, 3 of which only appear during Hardmode .

Hardy Saddle.name: Hardy Saddle
Hardy Saddle.tooltip: The Hardy Saddle is a mount-summoning item that summons a Turtle Mount that can swim and has increased movement speed in liquids (51 mph maximum), but reduced movement speed (26 mph maximum) and jump reach (3.53 tiles maximum) on land.

Pressure Plate Track.name: Pressure Plate Track
Pressure Plate Track.tooltip: Pressure Plate Tracks are activation mechanisms that work similarly to Pressure Plates and are activated while riding over with a Minecart.

King Slime Mask.name: King Slime Mask
King Slime Mask.tooltip: Masks are vanity items dropped by all non- event bosses , as well as those from the Old One's Army (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . They are worn in the social head slot.

Fin Wings.name: Fin Wings
Fin Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Treasure Map.name: Treasure Map

Seaweed Planter.name: Seaweed Planter

Pillagin' Me Pixels.name: Pillagin' Me Pixels
Pillagin' Me Pixels.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.

Boreal Wood Fence.name: Boreal Wood Fence
Boreal Wood Fence.tooltip: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences.

Palm Wood Greaves.tooltip: Palm Wood armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Palm Wood Helmet , Palm Wood Breastplate , and Palm Wood Greaves . Crafting a full set requires a total of 75 Palm Wood . The full set grants 4 defense while equipped.

Palm Wood Bow.name: Palm Wood Bow
Palm Wood Bow.tooltip: The Palm Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Palm Wood Hammer.name: Palm Wood Hammer
Palm Wood Hammer.tooltip: The Palm Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Palm Wood Sword.name: Palm Wood Sword
Palm Wood Sword.tooltip: The Palm Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Palm Wood Platform.name: Palm Wood Platform
Palm Wood Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Palm Wood Bathtub.name: Palm Wood Bathtub
Palm Wood Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Palm Wood Bed.name: Palm Wood Bed
Palm Wood Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Palm Wood Bench.name: Palm Wood Bench
Palm Wood Bench.tooltip: Benches are decorative furniture items that can take the place of chairs for the comfort requirement in NPCs ' housing .

Palm Wood Candelabra.name: Palm Wood Candelabra
Palm Wood Candelabra.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Palm Wood Candle.name: Palm Wood Candle
Palm Wood Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Palm Wood Chair.name: Palm Wood Chair
Palm Wood Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Palm Wood Chandelier.name: Palm Wood Chandelier
Palm Wood Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Palm Wood Chest.name: Palm Wood Chest
Palm Wood Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Palm Wood Sofa.name: Palm Wood Sofa
Palm Wood Sofa.tooltip: Sofas are vanity furniture items. There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 38 / (Old-gen console version) 21 craftable sofas and 5 noncraftable sofas. All are functionally identical, and differ only in their appearance. Sofas count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house for an NPC .

Palm Wood Door.name: Palm Wood Door
Palm Wood Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Palm Wood Dresser.name: Palm Wood Dresser
Palm Wood Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Palm Wood Lantern.name: Palm Wood Lantern
Palm Wood Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Palm Wood Piano.name: Palm Wood Piano
Palm Wood Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Palm Wood Table.name: Palm Wood Table
Palm Wood Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Palm Wood Lamp.name: Palm Wood Lamp
Palm Wood Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Palm Wood Work Bench.name: Palm Wood Work Bench
Palm Wood Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Optic Staff.name: Optic Staff
Optic Staff.tooltip: The Optic Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a miniature version of The Twins as minions.

Palm Wood Bookcase.name: Palm Wood Bookcase

Slime Hook.name: Slime Hook
Slime Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Sticky Grenade.name: Sticky Grenade
Sticky Grenade.tooltip: The Sticky Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon.

Tartar Sauce.name: Tartar Sauce
Tartar Sauce.tooltip: The Tartar Sauce is a pet-summoning item that spawns a Mini Minotaur that follows the player.

Duke Fishron Mask.name: Duke Fishron Mask
Duke Fishron Mask.tooltip: Masks are vanity items dropped by all non- event bosses , as well as those from the Old One's Army (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . They are worn in the social head slot.

Duke Fishron Trophy.name: Duke Fishron Trophy
Duke Fishron Trophy.tooltip: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 (10%) chance to be dropped from most bosses . While they can be considered the "boss version of banners ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses. Some trophies can only be rewarded by the Angler for completing fishing quests . In total, there are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 33 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 24 trophies.

The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Spider Fang.name: Spider Fang
Spider Fang.tooltip: The Spider Fang is a Hardmode crafting material dropped by Black Recluses in Spider Nests with a 1/2 (50%) / 9/10 (90%) chance.

Falcon Blade.name: Falcon Blade
Falcon Blade.tooltip: The Falcon Blade is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 38/625 (6.08%) chance of being obtained from Iron Crates and a 299/5000 (5.98%) chance from Mythril Crates.

Fishron Wings.name: Fishron Wings
Fishron Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Slime Gun.name: Slime Gun
Slime Gun.tooltip: The Slime Gun is a novelty item that auto-fires an arc of slime which inflicts the Slime debuff on players, enemies, and NPCs, causing them to drip blue goo for 30 seconds.

Flairon.name: Flairon
Flairon.tooltip: The Flairon is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Duke Fishron.

Green Dungeon Chest.name: Green Dungeon Chest
Green Dungeon Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Seashell.name: Seashell
Seashell.tooltip: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes.

Starfish.name: Starfish
Starfish.tooltip: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Steampunk Platform.name: Steampunk Platform
Steampunk Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Skyware Work Bench.name: Skyware Work Bench
Skyware Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Pumpkin Bed.name: Pumpkin Bed
Pumpkin Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Pumpkin Bookcase.name: Pumpkin Bookcase
Pumpkin Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Pumpkin Piano.name: Pumpkin Piano
Pumpkin Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Shark Statue.name: Shark Statue
Shark Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Truffle Worm.name: Truffle Worm
Truffle Worm.tooltip: The Truffle Worm is a rare Hardmode critter and boss-summoning item that spawns in the underground Glowing Mushroom biome.

Apprentice Bait.name: Apprentice Bait
Apprentice Bait.tooltip: Bait is a group of items that is mandatory for fishing . When a fishing pole is cast, at least one bait item must be in the player's inventory ; otherwise, nothing can be caught. Fishing poles will cast their lines with no baits, but there will be no "bites" and no catches. The bait item is only consumed once the player reels in the line with a catch on the hook. It is not consumed upon the player casting the line or the line being reeled in with no catch. Even when the player does reel in a fish, there is only a chance that the bait will be consumed.

Amber Gemspark Wall.name: Amber Gemspark Wall
Amber Gemspark Wall.tooltip: Gemspark Walls are the wall equivalent of Gemspark Blocks , and come in Online and Offline variants. Like Gemspark Blocks, Online Gemspark Walls emit light but do not count as a light source for NPC housing. Unlike Gemspark Blocks, Gemspark Walls do not act as Mechanisms and their online and offline states cannot be switched after being placed. Online Gemspark Walls placed behind blocks will cause the blocks to appear fully lit, similar to the effect of Illuminant Coating .

Offline Amber Gemspark Wall.name: Offline Amber Gemspark Wall
Offline Amber Gemspark Wall.tooltip: Offline Gemspark Walls are a group of walls made from Gemspark Blocks . Unlike Gemspark Blocks, they produce no light, and have no mechanical function . Gemspark Walls are the illuminant variant.

Living Fire Block.name: Living Fire Block
Living Fire Block.tooltip: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light.

'0' Statue.name: '0' Statue
'0' Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Firework Fountain.name: Firework Fountain
Firework Fountain.tooltip: The Firework Fountain is a placed novelty mechanism that, when activated, produces one of four colorful "sparkle fountain" effects.

Booster Track.name: Booster Track
Booster Track.tooltip: Booster Tracks are placeable furniture-type blocks that can be placed next to Minecart Tracks to automatically boost the speed of a Minecart that rides over it.

Grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
Grasshopper.tooltip: The Grasshopper is a type of critter that can be found when destroying grass plants and moves by hopping along the ground identically to slimes.

Grasshopper Cage.name: Grasshopper Cage
Grasshopper Cage.tooltip: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters . A critter caught with the Bug Net , Lavaproof Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , or Golden Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage. By throwing a cage into shimmer , it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the caged critter as an item.

Music Box (Underground Crimson).name: Music Box (Underground Crimson)
Music Box (Underground Crimson).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Cactus Table.name: Cactus Table
Cactus Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Cactus Platform.name: Cactus Platform
Cactus Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Boreal Wood Sword.name: Boreal Wood Sword
Boreal Wood Sword.tooltip: The Boreal Wood Sword is a pre-Hardmode broadsword and a variation of the Wooden Sword.

Boreal Wood Hammer.name: Boreal Wood Hammer
Boreal Wood Hammer.tooltip: The Boreal Wood Hammer is a pre-Hardmode hammer.

Boreal Wood Bow.name: Boreal Wood Bow
Boreal Wood Bow.tooltip: The Boreal Wood Bow is a pre-Hardmode bow and a variation of the Wooden Bow.

Glass Chest.name: Glass Chest
Glass Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Xeno Staff.name: Xeno Staff
Xeno Staff.tooltip: The Xeno Staff is a Hardmode, post-Golem summon weapon that summons a UFO minion.

Meteor Staff.name: Meteor Staff
Meteor Staff.tooltip: The Meteor Staff is a Hardmode wand. When used, it rapidly summons meteors from the sky which fall in the direction of the cursor and explode upon impact with an enemy or block.

Living Cursed Fire Block.name: Living Cursed Fire Block
Living Cursed Fire Block.tooltip: Living Fire Blocks are Hardmode animated background furniture blocks that, when placed, resemble small animated flames and emit faint orange light. They deal no damage on contact and can be freed with any pickaxe or drill . Living Fire Blocks have a 1/50 (2%) chance of being dropped by any enemy killed in the Underworld during Hardmode , including the Wall of Flesh , and drop in stacks of 20–50 at a time. [ 1 ]

Gender Change Potion.name: Gender Change Potion
Gender Change Potion.tooltip: The Gender Change Potion is a pre-Hardmode potion that allows the player to swap their character style between male and female.

Vortex Helmet.name: Vortex Helmet
Vortex Helmet.tooltip: Vortex armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet , Vortex Breastplate , and Vortex Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Vortex Fragments .

Vortex Breastplate.name: Vortex Breastplate
Vortex Breastplate.tooltip: Vortex armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet , Vortex Breastplate , and Vortex Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Vortex Fragments .

Vortex Leggings.name: Vortex Leggings
Vortex Leggings.tooltip: Vortex armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord ranged armor set consisting of the Vortex Helmet , Vortex Breastplate , and Vortex Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Vortex Fragments .

Nebula Helmet.name: Nebula Helmet
Nebula Helmet.tooltip: Nebula armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet , Nebula Breastplate , and Nebula Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Nebula Fragments .

Nebula Breastplate.name: Nebula Breastplate
Nebula Breastplate.tooltip: Nebula armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord mage armor set consisting of the Nebula Helmet , Nebula Breastplate , and Nebula Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Nebula Fragments .

Nebula Leggings.name: Nebula Leggings

Solar Flare Helmet.name: Solar Flare Helmet
Solar Flare Helmet.tooltip: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet , Solar Flare Breastplate , and Solar Flare Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Solar Fragments .

Solar Flare Breastplate.name: Solar Flare Breastplate
Solar Flare Breastplate.tooltip: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet , Solar Flare Breastplate , and Solar Flare Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Solar Fragments .

Solar Flare Leggings.name: Solar Flare Leggings
Solar Flare Leggings.tooltip: Solar Flare armor is a Hardmode , post- Moon Lord melee armor set consisting of the Solar Flare Helmet , Solar Flare Breastplate , and Solar Flare Leggings . Crafting the full set requires a total of 36 Luminite Bars (144 Luminite ) and 45 Solar Fragments .

Solar Tablet Fragment.name: Solar Tablet Fragment
Solar Tablet Fragment.tooltip: The Solar Tablet Fragment is a post-Plantera Hardmode crafting material used to craft the Solar Tablet, which summons the Solar Eclipse event.

Solar Tablet.name: Solar Tablet
Solar Tablet.tooltip: The Solar Tablet is a Hardmode event-summoning item used to summon a Solar Eclipse.

Drill Containment Unit.name: Drill Containment Unit
Drill Containment Unit.tooltip: The Drill Containment Unit (sometimes abbreviated to DCU) is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord mount-summoning item that summons a Drill Mount, a rideable, flying vehicle that mines tiles extremely quickly via a stream of blue lasers.

Cosmic Car Key.name: Cosmic Car Key
Cosmic Car Key.tooltip: The Cosmic Car Key is a Hardmode, post-Golem mount-summoning item.

Mothron Wings.name: Mothron Wings
Mothron Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Brain Scrambler.name: Brain Scrambler
Brain Scrambler.tooltip: The Brain Scrambler is a Hardmode, post-Golem enemy that appears during the Martian Madness event.

Vortex Axe.name: Vortex Axe
Vortex Axe.tooltip: Luminite Axes are unobtainable tools . The four types are the Solar Flare Axe , Vortex Axe , Nebula Axe , and the Stardust Axe , each themed after a different Celestial Tower . They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes . Even with Terrasavr and some other inventory editors, they seem to disappear, leaving an empty slot.

Vortex Chainsaw.name: Vortex Chainsaw
Vortex Chainsaw.tooltip: Luminite Chainsaws are unobtainable tools . All of the chainsaws share the same stats. The four types are the Solar Flare Chainsaw , Vortex Chainsaw , Nebula Chainsaw , and the Stardust Chainsaw , each themed after different Celestial Pillars . They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes .

Vortex Drill.name: Vortex Drill
Vortex Drill.tooltip: The Luminite Drills are Hardmode , post- Moon Lord drills . The four types are the Vortex Drill , Nebula Drill , Solar Flare Drill , and Stardust Drill . All four drills have identical stats and can mine all blocks .

Honeyfall Block.name: Honeyfall Block
Honeyfall Block.tooltip: The Honeyfall Block is a block that operates like the Waterfall Block and Lavafall Block, having an animated texture of flowing honey.

Honeyfall Wall.name: Honeyfall Wall
Honeyfall Wall.tooltip: The Honeyfall Wall is one of only a few animated background wall types.

Chlorophyte Brick Wall.name: Chlorophyte Brick Wall
Chlorophyte Brick Wall.tooltip: Chlorophyte Brick Walls are Walls that can be manually crafted.

Crimtane Brick Wall.name: Crimtane Brick Wall
Crimtane Brick Wall.tooltip: The Crimtane Brick Wall is a type of Wall made from Crimtane Brick.

Shroomite Plating Wall.name: Shroomite Plating Wall
Shroomite Plating Wall.tooltip: The Shroomite Plating Wall is a type of wall made from Shroomite Plating.

Chlorophyte Brick.name: Chlorophyte Brick
Chlorophyte Brick.tooltip: Chlorophyte Bricks are Hardmode bricks crafted from Chlorophyte Ore and Stone Blocks.

Crimtane Brick.name: Crimtane Brick
Crimtane Brick.tooltip: Crimtane Brick is a brick made from Crimtane Ore and Crimstone.

Shroomite Plating.name: Shroomite Plating
Shroomite Plating.tooltip: Shroomite Plating is a building material crafted from Stone Blocks and Shroomite Bars.

Laser Machinegun.name: Laser Machinegun
Laser Machinegun.tooltip: The Laser Machinegun is a Hardmode, post-Golem magic gun that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Electrosphere Launcher.name: Electrosphere Launcher
Electrosphere Launcher.tooltip: The Electrosphere Launcher is a Hardmode, post-Golem launcher that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Xenopopper.name: Xenopopper
Xenopopper.tooltip: The Xenopopper is a Hardmode, post-Golem gun that has a 1/6 (16.67%) chance of being dropped by the Martian Saucer during the Martian Madness event.

Laser Drill.name: Laser Drill
Laser Drill.tooltip: The Laser Drill is a Hardmode, post-Golem drill that has a 1/800 (0.13%) chance of being dropped from all basic enemies during the Martian Madness event.

Mechanical Ruler.name: Mechanical Ruler
Mechanical Ruler.tooltip: The Mechanical Ruler is an informational accessory that, when equipped, draws a cyan, semi-transparent grid overlay on the screen, making individual block distances much clearer.

Anti-Gravity Hook.name: Anti-Gravity Hook
Anti-Gravity Hook.tooltip: The Anti-Gravity Hook is a Hardmode, post-Golem grappling hook that fires up to three hooks which reach 31.25 tiles at maximum.

Moon Mask.name: Moon Mask
Moon Mask.tooltip: The Moon Mask is a vanity headpiece dropped by Lamias in Underground Deserts tainted with The Corruption or The Crimson.

Sun Mask.name: Sun Mask
Sun Mask.tooltip: The Sun Mask is a vanity helmet dropped by Lamias in normal Underground Deserts with a 1/25 (4%) chance.

Martian Costume Mask.name: Martian Costume Mask
Martian Costume Mask.tooltip: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask , Martian Costume Shirt , and Martian Costume Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gray Grunts , Ray Gunners , Scutlix Gunners , and Brain Scramblers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Costume Shirt.name: Martian Costume Shirt
Martian Costume Shirt.tooltip: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask , Martian Costume Shirt , and Martian Costume Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gray Grunts , Ray Gunners , Scutlix Gunners , and Brain Scramblers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Costume Pants.name: Martian Costume Pants
Martian Costume Pants.tooltip: The Martian Costume set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Costume Mask , Martian Costume Shirt , and Martian Costume Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gray Grunts , Ray Gunners , Scutlix Gunners , and Brain Scramblers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Uniform Helmet.name: Martian Uniform Helmet
Martian Uniform Helmet.tooltip: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet , Martian Uniform Torso , and Martian Uniform Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gigazappers , Martian Engineers , and Martian Officers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Uniform Torso.name: Martian Uniform Torso
Martian Uniform Torso.tooltip: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet , Martian Uniform Torso , and Martian Uniform Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gigazappers , Martian Engineers , and Martian Officers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Uniform Pants.name: Martian Uniform Pants
Martian Uniform Pants.tooltip: The Martian Uniform set is a Hardmode , post- Golem vanity set consisting of the Martian Uniform Helmet , Martian Uniform Torso , and Martian Uniform Pants . Each piece has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of being dropped by Gigazappers , Martian Engineers , and Martian Officers during the Martian Madness event .

Martian Astro Clock.name: Martian Astro Clock
Martian Astro Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Martian Bathtub.name: Martian Bathtub
Martian Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Martian Bed.name: Martian Bed
Martian Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Martian Hover Chair.name: Martian Hover Chair
Martian Hover Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Martian Chandelier.name: Martian Chandelier
Martian Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Martian Chest.name: Martian Chest
Martian Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Martian Door.name: Martian Door
Martian Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Martian Dresser.name: Martian Dresser
Martian Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Martian Holobookcase.name: Martian Holobookcase
Martian Holobookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Martian Hover Candle.name: Martian Hover Candle
Martian Hover Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Martian Lamppost.name: Martian Lamppost
Martian Lamppost.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Martian Lantern.name: Martian Lantern
Martian Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Martian Piano.name: Martian Piano
Martian Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Martian Platform.name: Martian Platform
Martian Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Martian Sofa.name: Martian Sofa
Martian Sofa.tooltip: Sofas are vanity furniture items. There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 38 / (Old-gen console version) 21 craftable sofas and 5 noncraftable sofas. All are functionally identical, and differ only in their appearance. Sofas count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house for an NPC .

Martian Table.name: Martian Table
Martian Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Martian Table Lamp.name: Martian Table Lamp
Martian Table Lamp.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Martian Work Bench.name: Martian Work Bench
Martian Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Wooden Sink.name: Wooden Sink
Wooden Sink.tooltip: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station . It does not fulfill a house 's flat surface or comfort item requirement, however, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

Solar Cultist Hood.name: Solar Cultist Hood
Solar Cultist Hood.tooltip: The Cultist set is a vanity set purchased from the Clothier for 20 GC (set) after the Lunatic Cultist has been defeated. Its appearance is based on the clothing worn by Cultists , but its design is different from the robes worn either by normal Lunatic Devotees or the Lunatic Cultist itself. These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.

Martian Conduit Plating.name: Martian Conduit Plating
Martian Conduit Plating.tooltip: Martian Conduit Plating is a post-Golem block dropped by most enemies during the Martian Madness event, and is used to create a variety of space- or Martian-themed furniture.

Martian Conduit Wall.name: Martian Conduit Wall
Martian Conduit Wall.tooltip: Martian Conduit Wall is a background wall type crafted from Martian Conduit Plating.

HiTek Sunglasses.name: HiTek Sunglasses
HiTek Sunglasses.tooltip: The HiTek Sunglasses are a Hardmode, post-Golem vanity item for the social helmet slot.

Martian Hair Dye.name: Martian Hair Dye
Martian Hair Dye.tooltip: Hair Dyes are consumable items sold by the Stylist NPC . When used, they replace a player's hair color with a dynamic effect.

Martian Dye.name: Martian Dye
Martian Dye.tooltip: Martian Dye is a Hardmode, post-Golem dye that is sometimes acquired from the Dye Trader after completing a Strange Plant quest.

Castle Marsberg.name: Castle Marsberg
Castle Marsberg.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

Martia Lisa.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Smoke Block.name: Smoke Block
Smoke Block.tooltip: Smoke Blocks are animated background furniture blocks that can be purchased from the Party Girl for 1 SC in Hardmode.

Living Flame Dye.name: Living Flame Dye
Living Flame Dye.tooltip: Living Flame Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader.

Living Rainbow Dye.name: Living Rainbow Dye
Living Rainbow Dye.tooltip: Living Rainbow Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader.

Shadow Dye.name: Shadow Dye
Shadow Dye.tooltip: Shadow Dye is a type of dye bought from the Dye Trader during a full moon, or given as a possible reward for turning in a Strange Plant in Hardmode.

Negative Dye.name: Negative Dye
Negative Dye.tooltip: Negative Dye is a type of dye bought from the Dye Trader during a full moon, or given as a possible reward for turning in a Strange Plant in Hardmode.

Living Ocean Dye.name: Living Ocean Dye
Living Ocean Dye.tooltip: Living Ocean Dye is a Hardmode dye acquired by giving a Strange Plant to the Dye Trader.

Brown Dye.name: Brown Dye
Brown Dye.tooltip: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor , vanity items , and accessories . The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes ( Silver Dye and Brown Dye ) as well as the Dye Vat ( 5 GC ). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes. There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 119 / (Old-gen console version) 68 different dyes in the game (118 / 67 on single-player worlds, as Team Dye is not available in single-player worlds). Some dyes will make sprites visible in complete darkness, most of which are Strange Dyes.

Phasic Warp Ejector.name: Phasic Warp Ejector

Vicious Powder.name: Vicious Powder
Vicious Powder.tooltip: Thrown Powders are consumable items that can be used to convert blocks and walls between their Crimson or Corrupt forms. When thrown, they release a cloud of sparkling powder with a very short range, comparable to that of a broadsword , and produce a fair amount of light. Thrown Powder comes in three variants:

Sparky.name: Sparky
Sparky.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

Vine Rope.name: Vine Rope
Vine Rope.tooltip: Ropes are placeable items that primarily provide quick vertical mobility. They can be placed adjacent to blocks in any direction, or in midair where background walls are present. Once placed, Ropes are used by pressing ▲ Up or ▼ Down while moving over them. Streamers and Chains operate identically to Rope, but cannot be crafted into Rope Coils .

Wormhole Potion.name: Wormhole Potion
Wormhole Potion.tooltip: The Wormhole Potion is a potion which allows a player to instantly teleport to another team member's location in multiplayer, done by selecting their player icon in the full-screen map (accessible by pressing the Toggle Full Map key) once consumed.

Summoner Emblem.name: Summoner Emblem
Summoner Emblem.tooltip: The Summoner Emblem is a Hardmode accessory that increases summon damage by 15%.

Bewitching Table.name: Bewitching Table
Bewitching Table.tooltip: The Bewitching Table is a furniture item found naturally placed in the Dungeon.

Alchemy Table.name: Alchemy Table
Alchemy Table.tooltip: The Alchemy Table is a post-Skeletron crafting station used to craft potions.

Strange Brew.name: Strange Brew
Strange Brew.tooltip: The Strange Brew is a pre-Hardmode recovery potion that can be purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC.

Spelunker Glowstick.name: Spelunker Glowstick
Spelunker Glowstick.tooltip: The Spelunker Glowstick is a consumable light source that can be held or tossed a fair distance, similar to the regular Glowstick.

Bone Arrow.name: Bone Arrow
Bone Arrow.tooltip: The Bone Arrow is a pre-Hardmode arrow purchased from the Skeleton Merchant for 15 CC each, during moon phases 1 (full), 2, 5 (new), and 6.

Bone Torch.name: Bone Torch
Bone Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Vine Rope Coil.name: Vine Rope Coil
Vine Rope Coil.tooltip: Rope Coils are consumable mobility items that, when thrown by the player , travel in an arc affected by gravity until striking a block. On making contact, a vertical string of ten pieces of the respective Rope type will be placed, starting from the point of contact and descending until the Rope runs out or makes contact with another block below. Once in place, the Ropes created by a Rope Coil are ordinary Rope items that can be climbed, expanded with other placed Ropes, and collected with a pickaxe or drill .

Life Drain.name: Life Drain
Life Drain.tooltip: The Life Drain is a Hardmode wand that has a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

Dart Pistol.name: Dart Pistol
Dart Pistol.tooltip: The Dart Pistol is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Crimson counterpart to the Corruption's Dart Rifle, with a higher rate of fire but lower damage.

Dart Rifle.name: Dart Rifle
Dart Rifle.tooltip: The Dart Rifle is a Hardmode ranged weapon that autofires darts as ammunition, and is the Corruption counterpart to the Crimson's Dart Pistol, with higher damage but a lower rate of fire.

Crystal Dart.name: Crystal Dart
Crystal Dart.tooltip: The Crystal Dart is a Hardmode dart. It can bounce between enemies and blocks, automatically targeting nearby enemies.

Cursed Dart.name: Cursed Dart
Cursed Dart.tooltip: The Cursed Dart is a Hardmode dart. As it travels, it releases cursed flames that fall and land on blocks, lingering for 2 seconds before dissipating.

Ichor Dart.name: Ichor Dart
Ichor Dart.tooltip: The Ichor Dart is a Hardmode dart. It can pierce infinitely when initially fired.

Chain Guillotines.name: Chain Guillotines
Chain Guillotines.tooltip: The Chain Guillotines are a Hardmode flail that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Corrupt Mimics.

Fetid Baghnakhs.name: Fetid Baghnakhs
Fetid Baghnakhs.tooltip: The Fetid Baghnakhs are a Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/5 (20%) chance of being dropped by Crimson Mimics.

Clinger Staff.name: Clinger Staff
Clinger Staff.tooltip: The Clinger Staff is a Hardmode magic weapon that generates a 15-tile high wall of Cursed Flame, which deals damage and inflicts the Cursed Inferno debuff to enemies that walk through it for a duration of 7 seconds.

Putrid Scent.name: Putrid Scent
Putrid Scent.tooltip: The Putrid Scent is a Hardmode accessory which increases damage and critical strike chance by 5% and decreases aggro by 400.

Flesh Knuckles.name: Flesh Knuckles
Flesh Knuckles.tooltip: The Flesh Knuckles are a Hardmode accessory that increases the player's defense by 8 and aggro by 400.

Flower Boots.name: Flower Boots

Hellwing Bow.name: Hellwing Bow

A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Celestial Shell.tooltip: The Celestial Shell is a Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that combines the stat-boosting powers of the Celestial Stone with the transformation powers of the Moon Shell, allowing both of their effects to happen simultaneously while taking only one accessory slot.

Pink Gel.name: Pink Gel
Pink Gel.tooltip: Pink Gel is a rare crafting material dropped by Pinky in stacks of 25–50.

Bouncy Glowstick.name: Bouncy Glowstick
Bouncy Glowstick.tooltip: The Bouncy Glowstick is a consumable light source that bounces off surfaces while also providing light.

Pink Slime Block.name: Pink Slime Block
Pink Slime Block.tooltip: The Pink Slime Block can be created with Pink Gel if the player is near a Solidifier.

Pink Torch.name: Pink Torch
Pink Torch.tooltip: Torches are furniture items that produce light when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw key), and are crucial at all stages of gameplay as primary light sources . Torches provide light permanently, and are never extinguished. Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

Bouncy Bomb.name: Bouncy Bomb
Bouncy Bomb.tooltip: The Bouncy Bomb is an explosive that functions like the Bomb, but bounces off blocks more intensely before exploding.

Bouncy Grenade.name: Bouncy Grenade
Bouncy Grenade.tooltip: The Bouncy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon made of Pink Gel and Grenades.

Peace Candle.name: Peace Candle
Peace Candle.tooltip: The Peace Candle is a furniture item that can be placed or held to decrease enemy and critter spawn rates in the area and emits a low amount of light.

Lifeform Analyzer.name: Lifeform Analyzer
Lifeform Analyzer.tooltip: The Lifeform Analyzer is an informational accessory that displays the name of rare enemies, critters, and undiscovered NPCs (see list below) within 81.25 tiles around the player.

DPS Meter.name: DPS Meter
DPS Meter.tooltip: The DPS Meter is an informational accessory that displays the DPS of the weapon that last dealt damage to any entity, including enemies, critters, NPCs, Target Dummies, and other players.

Fisherman's Pocket Guide.name: Fisherman's Pocket Guide
Fisherman's Pocket Guide.tooltip: The Fisherman's Pocket Guide is an informational accessory that displays the player's current Fishing Power.

Goblin Tech.name: Goblin Tech
Goblin Tech.tooltip: The Goblin Tech is an informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of the most valuable block nearby, the player's current DPS, and their current movement speed.

R.E.K. 3000.name: R.E.K. 3000
R.E.K. 3000.tooltip: The R.E.K. 3000 is a post-Skeletron informational accessory that enables an on-screen display of nearby rare creatures, the number of nearby enemies, and the player's enemy kill count.

Cell Phone.name: Cell Phone
Cell Phone.tooltip: The Cell Phone is a post-Skeletron informational item and tool that combines the functions of the PDA and the Magic Mirrors, displaying all information and allowing the player to teleport to their spawn point.

Granite Chest.name: Granite Chest
Granite Chest.tooltip: The Granite Chest is a chest storage item found only in Underground Cabins within Granite Caves.

Meteorite Clock.name: Meteorite Clock
Meteorite Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Meteorite Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Meteorite Dresser.name: Meteorite Dresser
Meteorite Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Marble Dresser.name: Marble Dresser
Marble Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Meteorite Lamp.name: Meteorite Lamp
Meteorite Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Meteorite Lantern.name: Meteorite Lantern
Meteorite Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Meteorite Platform.name: Meteorite Platform
Meteorite Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Meteorite Sink.tooltip: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station . It does not fulfill a house 's flat surface or comfort item requirement, however, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

All are functionally identical, and differ only in their appearance. Sofas count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house for an NPC .

They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Meteorite Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Meteorite Bed.name: Meteorite Bed
Meteorite Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Meteorite Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Meteorite Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Meteorite Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Marble Chest.name: Marble Chest
Marble Chest.tooltip: The Marble Chest is a chest storage item found only in Underground Cabins within Marble Caves.

Magic Water Dropper.name: Magic Water Dropper
Magic Water Dropper.tooltip: Magic Droppers are Hardmode items used to place "droplets" — dripping liquid effects on ceilings. Once placed, they permanently display an intermittent dripping effect. The effect is purely visual, and has no functional use. Magic Droppers are crafted with an Empty Dropper at Water , Lava , Honey , or with any Sand , with the Crystal Ball nearby.

Enchanted Nightcrawler.name: Enchanted Nightcrawler

Grubby.name: Grubby
Grubby.tooltip: Grubby is one of three critters that occasionally spawn in the Jungle or Underground Jungle biome when a player breaks a plant, the others being Sluggy (rarer) and Buggy (rarest).

Sluggy.name: Sluggy

Buggy.name: Buggy

Grub Soup.name: Grub Soup

Bomb Fish.name: Bomb Fish

Frost Daggerfish.name: Frost Daggerfish
Frost Daggerfish.tooltip: The Frost Daggerfish is a consumable ranged weapon.

Sharpening Station.name: Sharpening Station

Ice Mirror.name: Ice Mirror
Ice Mirror.tooltip: The Magic Mirror is a pre-Hardmode tool . When used, it plays an animation before teleporting the player to their spawn point . Compared to the Recall Potion , the Magic Mirror has unlimited uses, but a longer delay before teleporting.

Sailfish Boots.name: Sailfish Boots

Money Trough.name: Money Trough
Money Trough.tooltip: The Money Trough is a portable storage item that temporarily summons a flying pet-like version of the Piggy Bank.

Bubble.name: Bubble

Daybloom Planter Box.name: Daybloom Planter Box
Daybloom Planter Box.tooltip: Planter Boxes are special gardening objects purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space . [ 1 ] The plant in a Planter Box cannot be cut in the regular manner, e.g. via nearby swinging tools. Instead, it needs to be removed with a pickaxe or drill , or the Staff of Regrowth or Axe of Regrowth .

Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet.name: Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet
Lazure's Valkyrie Circlet.tooltip: Lazure's set are vanity developer items that can be obtained rarely (6.25% chance) from Treasure Bags dropped from Hardmode bosses (except Queen Slime 's). It is the vanity set made for Lazure , a former artist at Re-Logic .

Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak.name: Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak
Lazure's Valkyrie Cloak.tooltip: Lazure's set are vanity developer items that can be obtained rarely (6.25% chance) from Treasure Bags dropped from Hardmode bosses (except Queen Slime 's). It is the vanity set made for Lazure , a former artist at Re-Logic .

Lazure's Barrier Platform.name: Lazure's Barrier Platform
Lazure's Barrier Platform.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Golden Cross Grave Marker.name: Golden Cross Grave Marker
Golden Cross Grave Marker.tooltip: A Tombstone is a furniture item that drops when a player dies . It can then be retrieved and used much like a sign or as a form of decoration . By default, it contains the death message generated based on how the player died along with the real-life date of the death.

Music Box (Martian Madness).name: Music Box (Martian Madness)
Music Box (Martian Madness).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Music Box (Pirate Invasion).name: Music Box (Pirate Invasion)
Music Box (Pirate Invasion).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . Trap Door.name: Trap Door
Trap Door.tooltip: Trap Doors are furniture items. They are essentially full-block horizontal Doors.

Tall Gate.name: Tall Gate
Tall Gate.tooltip: The Tall Gate is a furniture item which is essentially a tall, sliding door that can be opened and closed by pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it.

Sharkron Balloon.name: Sharkron Balloon
Sharkron Balloon.tooltip: The Sharkron Balloon is an accessory that combines the effects of the Tsunami in a Bottle and the Balloon Pufferfish.

Tax Collector's Hat.name: Tax Collector's Hat
Tax Collector's Hat.tooltip: The Tax Collector's set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tax Collector's Hat , the Tax Collector's Suit and the Tax Collector's Pants . It is purchased from the Clothier for 9 GC (set) when the Tax Collector is present in the world.

Tax Collector's Suit.name: Tax Collector's Suit
Tax Collector's Suit.tooltip: The Tax Collector's set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Tax Collector's Hat , the Tax Collector's Suit and the Tax Collector's Pants . It is purchased from the Clothier for 9 GC (set) when the Tax Collector is present in the world.

Tax Collector's Pants.name: Tax Collector's Pants

Bone Glove.name: Bone Glove
Bone Glove.tooltip: The Bone Glove is a pre-Hardmode accessory that throws ricocheting crossbones every time a weapon is used, at a maximum of once per second.

Clothier's Jacket.name: Clothier's Jacket
Clothier's Jacket.tooltip: The Clothier's set is a vanity set consisting of the Red Hat , Clothier's Jacket (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , and Clothier's Pants (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.

Clothier's Pants.name: Clothier's Pants
Clothier's Pants.tooltip: The Clothier's set is a vanity set consisting of the Red Hat , Clothier's Jacket (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , and Clothier's Pants (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . Dye Trader's Turban.name: Dye Trader's Turban
Dye Trader's Turban.tooltip: The Dye Trader's set is a vanity set consisting up of the Dye Trader's Turban (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) and the Dye Trader Robe . These items are to be equipped in the Social Slots as they only provide a visual appearance.

Deadly Sphere Staff.name: Deadly Sphere Staff
Deadly Sphere Staff.tooltip: The Deadly Sphere Staff is a Hardmode, post-Plantera summon weapon that summons a Deadly Sphere minion.

Green Horseshoe Balloon.name: Green Horseshoe Balloon
Green Horseshoe Balloon.tooltip: The Green Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33%, jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck.

Amber Horseshoe Balloon.name: Amber Horseshoe Balloon
Amber Horseshoe Balloon.tooltip: The Amber Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that increases jump height by 75% (6 blocks → 10.5 blocks), reduces it by 15% when underwater (8 blocks → 7 blocks), makes the player immune to fall damage, and releases bees when attacked, which seek out and damage enemies.

Pink Horseshoe Balloon.name: Pink Horseshoe Balloon
Pink Horseshoe Balloon.tooltip: The Pink Horseshoe Balloon is an accessory that grants immunity to fall damage, increases jump height by 33% and jump speed by 30%, grants a double jump, and grants +0.05 luck.

Lava Lamp.name: Lava Lamp
Lava Lamp.tooltip: The Lava Lamp is a furniture item purchased from the Party Girl for 2 GC, that emits a small amount of light and has an animated texture.

Enchanted Nightcrawler Cage.name: Enchanted Nightcrawler Cage
Enchanted Nightcrawler Cage.tooltip: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters . A critter caught with the Bug Net , Lavaproof Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , or Golden Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage. By throwing a cage into shimmer , it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the caged critter as an item.

Buggy Cage.name: Buggy Cage
Buggy Cage.tooltip: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters . Slap Hand.name: Slap Hand

Twilight Hair Dye.name: Twilight Hair Dye
Twilight Hair Dye.tooltip: Hair Dyes are consumable items sold by the Stylist NPC . When used, they replace a player's hair color with a dynamic effect.

Blessed Apple.name: Blessed Apple
Blessed Apple.tooltip: The Blessed Apple is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that summons a rideable Unicorn Mount, capable of an extra jump as well as the ability to sprint and charge through enemies, damaging them in the process.

Spectre Bar.name: Spectre Bar
Spectre Bar.tooltip: The Spectre Bar is a Hardmode, post-Plantera bar.

Code 1.name: Code 1
Code 1.tooltip: The Code 1 is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 5 GC once the Eye of Cthulhu has been defeated.

Buccaneer Bandana.name: Buccaneer Bandana
Buccaneer Bandana.tooltip: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana , Buccaneer Tunic , and Buccaneer Pantaloons . Each piece has a 1/500 (0.2%) chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands , Pirate Corsairs , Pirate Deadeyes , and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event .

Buccaneer Tunic.name: Buccaneer Tunic
Buccaneer Tunic.tooltip: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana , Buccaneer Tunic , and Buccaneer Pantaloons . Each piece has a 1/500 (0.2%) chance of being dropped by Pirate Deckhands , Pirate Corsairs , Pirate Deadeyes , and Pirate Crossbowers during the Pirate Invasion event .

Buccaneer Pantaloons.name: Buccaneer Pantaloons
Buccaneer Pantaloons.tooltip: The Buccaneer set is a Hardmode vanity set consisting of the Buccaneer Bandana , Buccaneer Tunic , and Buccaneer Pantaloons .
