Obsidian Outlaw Hat.name: Obsidian Outlaw Hat
Obsidian Outlaw Hat.tooltip: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat , Obsidian Longcoat , and Obsidian Pants . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian , 30 Silk , and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples .

Obsidian Longcoat.name: Obsidian Longcoat
Obsidian Longcoat.tooltip: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat , Obsidian Longcoat , and Obsidian Pants . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian , 30 Silk , and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples .

Obsidian Pants.name: Obsidian Pants
Obsidian Pants.tooltip: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat , Obsidian Longcoat , and Obsidian Pants . Crafting a full set requires a total of 60 Obsidian , 30 Silk , and 20 Shadow Scales or Tissue Samples .

Medusa Head.name: Medusa Head
Medusa Head.tooltip: The Medusa Head is a Hardmode magic weapon that continuously fires close-range yellow beams up to four times per second, hitting up to three enemies per attack within a short radius of the player.

Item Frame.name: Item Frame
Item Frame.tooltip: The Item Frame is a furniture item that can be placed on a 2×2 area of background wall, placed on or hung from blocks, or placed on top of platforms.

Sandstone Block.name: Sandstone Block
Sandstone Block.tooltip: Sandstone Blocks are found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome.

Hardened Sand Block.name: Hardened Sand Block
Hardened Sand Block.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block, along with Sandstone Blocks, that make up the Underground Desert biome.

Sandstone Wall.name: Sandstone Wall
Sandstone Wall.tooltip: The Sandstone Wall, Ebonsandstone Wall, Crimsandstone Wall, and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Hardened Ebonsand Block.name: Hardened Ebonsand Block
Hardened Ebonsand Block.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block , along with Sandstone Blocks , that make up the Underground Desert biome . It looks similar to Sand Blocks , with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity. Like all sand-based blocks, it has Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Hardened Ebonsand , Hardened Crimsand , and Hardened Pearlsand respectively.

Hardened Crimsand Block.name: Hardened Crimsand Block
Hardened Crimsand Block.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block , along with Sandstone Blocks , that make up the Underground Desert biome . It looks similar to Sand Blocks , with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity. Like all sand-based blocks, it has Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Hardened Ebonsand , Hardened Crimsand , and Hardened Pearlsand respectively.

Ebonsandstone Block.name: Ebonsandstone Block
Ebonsandstone Block.tooltip: Sandstone Blocks are found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome . Like Sand and Hardened Sand , they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone , Crimsandstone , and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Crimsandstone Block.name: Crimsandstone Block
Crimsandstone Block.tooltip: Sandstone Blocks are found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome . Like Sand and Hardened Sand , they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone , Crimsandstone , and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Wooden Yoyo.name: Wooden Yoyo
Wooden Yoyo.tooltip: The Wooden Yoyo is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Malaise.name: Malaise
Malaise.tooltip: The Malaise is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Artery.name: Artery
Artery.tooltip: The Artery is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Amazon.name: Amazon
Amazon.tooltip: The Amazon is a pre-Hardmode yoyo.

Cascade.name: Cascade
Cascade.tooltip: The Cascade is a pre-Hardmode-only, post-Skeletron yoyo that has a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld.

Chik.name: Chik
Chik.tooltip: The Chik is a Hardmode yoyo.

Code 2.name: Code 2
Code 2.tooltip: The Code 2 is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 25 GC.

Rally.name: Rally
Rally.tooltip: The Rally is a pre-Hardmode yoyo that has a 3.9% chance of being dropped by Crawdads, Giant Shellies, and Salamanders in the Cavern layer.

Yelets.name: Yelets
Yelets.tooltip: The Yelets is a Hardmode, post one-mechanical boss yoyo that has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance to drop from any enemy killed in the Jungle and Underground Jungle, including in the Jungle Temple.

Red's Throw.name: Red's Throw
Red's Throw.tooltip: Red's Throw is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Red's set.

Valkyrie Yoyo.name: Valkyrie Yoyo
Valkyrie Yoyo.tooltip: The Valkyrie Yoyo is a Hardmode, Expert Mode-exclusive yoyo that can be obtained from any Hardmode boss's Treasure Bag (except Queen Slime's) as part of Lazure's set.

Amarok.name: Amarok
Amarok.tooltip: The Amarok is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of being dropped from any enemy in the Snow biome, and can also drop in a Corrupted, Crimsoned, or Hallowed Snow biome.

Hel-Fire.name: Hel-Fire
Hel-Fire.tooltip: The Hel-Fire is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of being dropped by any enemy in or near The Underworld.

Kraken.name: Kraken
Kraken.tooltip: The Kraken is a Hardmode, post-Plantera yoyo that has a 1/400 (0.25%) chance to drop from any enemy in the Dungeon.

The Eye of Cthulhu.name: The Eye of Cthulhu
The Eye of Cthulhu.tooltip: The Eye of Cthulhu is a Hardmode, post-Plantera yoyo that has a 1/3 (33.33%) / 5/9 (55.56%) chance of being dropped by Mothrons during a Solar Eclipse.

Red String.name: Red String
Red String.tooltip: A string is an offensive accessory that increases the range of any yoyo -type weapon when put into an accessory slot. While this item is equipped, the weapon's reach becomes 125% of its base value, plus an additional 2-tile range bonus. [ 1 ] White String is first crafted by the player with 30 Cobwebs at a Loom , and can be combined with certain dyes to form colored variants. These colored strings will be displayed as the color of the yoyo's string when it is thrown in addition to providing the additional range. However, they will also apply their color changes in a vanity slot.

Treasure Bag (King Slime).name: Treasure Bag (King Slime)
Treasure Bag (King Slime).tooltip: Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

Yoyo Glove.name: Yoyo Glove
Yoyo Glove.tooltip: The Yoyo Glove is a Hardmode accessory that aids yoyo attacks.

Demon Heart.name: Demon Heart
Demon Heart.tooltip: The Demon Heart is a Hardmode permanent booster item that permanently grants the player an extra accessory slot, for use only within Expert and Master Mode worlds.

Spore Sac.name: Spore Sac
Spore Sac.tooltip: The Spore Sac is a Hardmode, post-Plantera accessory that is always dropped from Plantera's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Shiny Stone.name: Shiny Stone
Shiny Stone.tooltip: The Shiny Stone is an Hardmode, post-Golem accessory that increases the rate of health regeneration slowly over time when the player is not moving or using any tools or weapons.

Hardened Pearlsand Block.name: Hardened Pearlsand Block
Hardened Pearlsand Block.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Block is a type of block , along with Sandstone Blocks , that make up the Underground Desert biome . It looks similar to Sand Blocks , with an altered texture and slightly different color. Unlike sand, it is not affected by gravity. Like all sand-based blocks, it has Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Hardened Ebonsand , Hardened Crimsand , and Hardened Pearlsand respectively.

Pearlsandstone Block.name: Pearlsandstone Block
Pearlsandstone Block.tooltip: Sandstone Blocks are found naturally placed in the Underground Desert biome . Like Sand and Hardened Sand , they are corruptable blocks in Hardmode, and have Corruption , Crimson , and Hallowed counterparts: Ebonsandstone , Crimsandstone , and Pearlsandstone respectively.

Hardened Sand Wall.name: Hardened Sand Wall
Hardened Sand Wall.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Wall, Hardened Ebonsand Wall, Hardened Crimsand Wall, and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert, considered unsafe.

Hardened Ebonsand Wall.name: Hardened Ebonsand Wall
Hardened Ebonsand Wall.tooltip: The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

Exotic Scimitar.name: Exotic Scimitar
Exotic Scimitar.tooltip: The Exotic Scimitar is a pre-Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped from the Dye Trader.

Paintball Gun.name: Paintball Gun
Paintball Gun.tooltip: The Paintball Gun is a pre-Hardmode ranged weapon that fires a three-shot burst of slow-moving, arcing multicolored projectiles which consume no mana or ammunition, dissipating upon contact with an enemy or surface.

Classy Cane.name: Classy Cane
Classy Cane.tooltip: The Classy Cane is a Hardmode broadsword that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance to be dropped by the Tax Collector.

Stylish Scissors.name: Stylish Scissors
Stylish Scissors.tooltip: The Stylish Scissors are a pre-Hardmode broadsword that have a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by the Stylist.

Mechanical Cart.name: Mechanical Cart
Mechanical Cart.tooltip: Minecarts are mounts that allow players to ride on Minecart Tracks . When the player is near a Minecart Track, pressing the Quick Mount hotkey or pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate key on a point on the track causes a Minecart to spawn, which the player is automatically placed in. Once inside, the ▶ Right and ◀ Left direction keys either accelerate, decelerate, or reverse the cart's movement. The cart will maintain its current speed and direction if no keys are pressed and no obstacles are reached. The cart can also "jump" with the ↷ Jump key.

Mechanical Wheel Piece.name: Mechanical Wheel Piece
Mechanical Wheel Piece.tooltip: The Mechanical Wheel Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit, and is always dropped from The Twins' Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Mechanical Wagon Piece.name: Mechanical Wagon Piece
Mechanical Wagon Piece.tooltip: The Mechanical Wagon Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit, and is always dropped from The Destroyer's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Mechanical Battery Piece.name: Mechanical Battery Piece
Mechanical Battery Piece.tooltip: The Mechanical Battery Piece is one of three parts needed to craft the Minecart Upgrade Kit, and is always dropped from Skeletron Prime's Treasure Bag in Expert Mode.

Lunatic Cultist Trophy.name: Lunatic Cultist Trophy
Lunatic Cultist Trophy.tooltip: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 (10%) chance to be dropped from most bosses . While they can be considered the "boss version of banners ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses. Some trophies can only be rewarded by the Angler for completing fishing quests . In total, there are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 33 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 24 trophies.

Chimney.name: Chimney
Chimney.tooltip: The Chimney is a decorative structure with a style similar to a Fireplace.

Yoyo Bag.name: Yoyo Bag
Yoyo Bag.tooltip: The Yoyo Bag is a Hardmode accessory which combines the functionalities of the Yoyo Glove, a counterweight, and string.

Shrimpy Truffle.name: Shrimpy Truffle
Shrimpy Truffle.tooltip: The Shrimpy Truffle is a Hardmode mount-summoning item that spawns Cute Fishron, a miniature rideable Duke Fishron-style mount that can fly and hover indefinitely.

Arkhalis.name: Arkhalis
Arkhalis.tooltip: The Arkhalis is a Hardmode melee weapon that is part of Arkhalis' set and is only obtainable through Hardmode Treasure Bags in Expert Mode (except Queen Slime's).

Confetti Cannon.name: Confetti Cannon
Confetti Cannon.tooltip: The Confetti Cannon is a Hardmode novelty furniture/mechanism.

Music Box (The Towers).name: Music Box (The Towers)
Music Box (The Towers).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Music Box (Goblin Invasion).name: Music Box (Goblin Invasion)
Music Box (Goblin Invasion).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Moon Lord Mask.name: Moon Lord Mask
Moon Lord Mask.tooltip: Masks are vanity items dropped by all non- event bosses , as well as those from the Old One's Army (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) . They are worn in the social head slot.

Stardust Helmet.name: Stardust Helmet

Portal Gun.name: Portal Gun

Terrarian.name: Terrarian
Terrarian.tooltip: The Terrarian is a Hardmode yoyo that has a 2/9 (22.22%) chance of being dropped by the Moon Lord.

Goblin Warlock Banner.name: Goblin Warlock Banner
Goblin Warlock Banner.tooltip: Enemy banners are functional furniture items that can be placed on the underside of blocks and platforms . They are dropped by most enemies and a few critters .

Stardust Axe.name: Stardust Axe
Stardust Axe.tooltip: Luminite Axes are unobtainable tools . The four types are the Solar Flare Axe , Vortex Axe , Nebula Axe , and the Stardust Axe , each themed after a different Celestial Tower . They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes . Even with Terrasavr and some other inventory editors, they seem to disappear, leaving an empty slot.

Stardust Chainsaw.name: Stardust Chainsaw
Stardust Chainsaw.tooltip: Luminite Chainsaws are unobtainable tools . All of the chainsaws share the same stats. The four types are the Solar Flare Chainsaw , Vortex Chainsaw , Nebula Chainsaw , and the Stardust Chainsaw , each themed after different Celestial Pillars . They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes .

Stardust Drill.name: Stardust Drill
Stardust Drill.tooltip: The Luminite Drills are Hardmode , post- Moon Lord drills . The four types are the Vortex Drill , Nebula Drill , Solar Flare Drill , and Stardust Drill . They are the alternative versions of the Luminite Pickaxes , having a faster mining speed but shorter range and lacking the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. All four drills have identical stats and can mine all blocks .

Stardust Hammer.name: Stardust Hammer
Stardust Hammer.tooltip: Luminite Hammers are unobtainable tools . The four types are the Solar Flare Hammer , Vortex Hammer , Nebula Hammer , and the Stardust Hammer , each themed after a different Celestial Tower . They are all unable to be crafted, and instead the player must craft the Luminite Hamaxes .

Stardust Pickaxe.name: Stardust Pickaxe
Stardust Pickaxe.tooltip: Luminite Pickaxes are Hardmode , post- Moon Lord pickaxes . The four types are the Solar Flare Pickaxe , Vortex Pickaxe , Nebula Pickaxe , and Stardust Pickaxe . They are the alternate versions of the Luminite Drills , having a slower mining speed but longer range and the ability to benefit from mining speed bonuses. All four pickaxes have identical stats and can mine all blocks .

Luminite Bar.name: Luminite Bar
Luminite Bar.tooltip: The Luminite Bar is a Hardmode, post-Moon Lord bar.

Solar Wings.name: Solar Wings
Solar Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Blood Water.name: Blood Water
Blood Water.tooltip: Thrown Water refers to a set of three consumable weapons that each convert a small area into a biome ( Hallow , Corruption , or Crimson for Holy Water , Unholy Water , and Blood Water respectively) when thrown. Enemies within this radius are also damaged slightly; this damage is not classified as any of the four damage types and therefore cannot be modified by any buffs or equipment.

Vortex Monolith.tooltip: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during events or under other special circumstances. When placed, they can be toggled with the ⚷ Open / Activate button or via wire , like other mechanisms , providing their effects in a small area around them. They can also be equipped as vanity accessories , which enables their effect globally for the player, similarly to the Radio Thing .

Super Healing Potion.name: Super Healing Potion

Detonator.name: Detonator
Detonator.tooltip: Detonators are activation Mechanisms that can be found underground as part of Traps, wired to Explosives.

Bouncy Dynamite.name: Bouncy Dynamite
Bouncy Dynamite.tooltip: Bouncy Dynamite is the opposite of Sticky Dynamite, and will bounce much more than ordinary Dynamite before it explodes.

Happy Grenade.name: Happy Grenade
Happy Grenade.tooltip: The Happy Grenade is an explosive consumable ranged weapon that inflicts half the damage of an ordinary Grenade and displays a confetti effect.

Ancient Manipulator.name: Ancient Manipulator
Ancient Manipulator.tooltip: The Ancient Manipulator is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist crafting station mainly used to craft items from Luminite and Lunar Fragments.

Flame and Silver Dye.name: Flame and Silver Dye
Flame and Silver Dye.tooltip: Dyes are items that can be placed in the "dye slots" of a player's inventory to alter the colors and/or textures of equipped armor , vanity items , and accessories . The Dye Trader NPC sells two dyes ( Silver Dye and Brown Dye ) as well as the Dye Vat ( 5 GC ). The other dyes must be crafted using the Dye Vat or obtained through trading in Strange Plants to the Dye Trader. Primary crafted dyes can be further combined to craft Bright, Gradient, and Compound dyes. There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 119 / (Old-gen console version) 68 different dyes in the game (118 / 67 on single-player worlds, as Team Dye is not available in single-player worlds). Some dyes will make sprites visible in complete darkness, most of which are Strange Dyes.

Red Squirrel.name: Red Squirrel
Red Squirrel.tooltip: The Squirrel and Red Squirrel (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) are harmless critters that spawn in the Forest biome . They also have a small chance of spawning upon shaking a Forest or Pearlwood tree .

Gold Squirrel.name: Gold Squirrel
Gold Squirrel.tooltip: The Gold Squirrel is a harmless critter. It is a golden recolor of the ordinary Squirrel, with a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of spawning in place of the ordinary version.

Red Squirrel Cage.name: Red Squirrel Cage
Red Squirrel Cage.tooltip: Cages are placeable decorative furniture items that display animated critters . A critter caught with the Bug Net , Lavaproof Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , or Golden Bug Net (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) is combined with a Terrarium to craft a cage. By throwing a cage into shimmer , it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the caged critter as an item.

Jim's Wings.name: Jim's Wings
Jim's Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Moon Lord Trophy.name: Moon Lord Trophy
Moon Lord Trophy.tooltip: Trophies are decorative furniture items which usually have a 1/10 (10%) chance to be dropped from most bosses . While they can be considered the "boss version of banners ", they are purely cosmetic and do not provide any bonuses. Some trophies can only be rewarded by the Angler for completing fishing quests . In total, there are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 33 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 24 trophies.

Not a Kid, nor a Squid.name: Not a Kid, nor a Squid
Not a Kid, nor a Squid.tooltip: Paintings are decorative furniture items that can be placed on background walls . Each one is a framed image that depicts a particular scene, usually Terraria -related. Their tooltips generally contain a person's name, intended to credit each painting's artist; although the names appear to be fictional, most of them correspond to known Terraria developers, artists, testing staff, and community members ( see Trivia below ) . (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) Paintings are highlighted by Spelunker Potions , the Magic Lantern , Spelunker Glowsticks , and Spelunker Flares .

Celestial Sigil.tooltip: The Celestial Sigil is a Hardmode, post-Lunatic Cultist boss-summoning item that summons the Moon Lord when used.

Logic Gate Lamp (Off).name: Logic Gate Lamp (Off)
Logic Gate Lamp (Off).tooltip: A Logic Gate Lamp is a mechanism that is placed atop a Logic Gate or another Logic Gate Lamp. The Logic Gate is activated based on its type and the states of the Logic Gate Lamps atop it. The state of a Logic Gate Lamp is toggled via wire . The Logic Gate Lamps, along with the Logic Gates, are purchased from the Steampunker .

Logic Gate (AND).name: Logic Gate (AND)
Logic Gate (AND).tooltip: A Logic Gate is a mechanism used to provide logic to wiring setups. Input is provided using a stack of Logic Gate Lamps placed on top of it. The logic gate turns on and off depending on its inputs, and emits a signal every time its state changes.

They have the unique ability to automatically move players, dropped items , placed Golf Balls and town NPCs (but not enemies or critters ) in their respective direction upon contact.

The Grand Design.name: The Grand Design

Yellow Wrench.name: Yellow Wrench
Yellow Wrench.tooltip: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires , which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate . There are four different wrenches: the Red Wrench , Green Wrench , Blue Wrench , and Yellow Wrench (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , each placing its respective color of Wire. All wrenches are purchased from the Mechanic for 2 GC each.

Logic Sensor (Day).name: Logic Sensor (Day)
Logic Sensor (Day).tooltip: Sensors are Hardmode mechanisms that emit a signal under specific circumstances. There are 7 different types of sensors, split into 2 sub-categories: Logic Sensors and Liquid Sensors.

Logic Sensor (Night).name: Logic Sensor (Night)

Announcement Box.name: Announcement Box
Announcement Box.tooltip: The Announcement Box is a special sign that, when powered, will announce (in the chat) what was written on the sign.

Actuation Rod.name: Actuation Rod

Red Team Block.name: Red Team Block

Large Amber.name: Large Amber
Large Amber.tooltip: Large Gems are items designed for the PvP game Capture the Gem , and are dropped when the player dies , even if they are in Classic or Softcore mode . With each different Large Gem that is held or carried in the player's inventory, a hologram of it appears above the player's head. If two or more different Large Gems are carried, their holograms will revolve in a circular pattern above the player's head. They are immediately deleted if placed in a player's trash slot [ 1 ] .

Ruby Gem Lock.name: Ruby Gem Lock
Ruby Gem Lock.tooltip: A Gem Lock is a special mechanism which acts as a container or altar for a Large Gem . A Gem Lock will emit an activation signal if the corresponding Large Gem is placed inside it and once again if it gets removed. This allows for a simple contraption that uses only one mechanism to keep something like a door open as long as the gem is inside the lock, because if it gets taken out it will immediately close.

While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Explosive Traps do not disappear when exploding, and will remain until its duration has expired [ 1 ] or when the Old One's Army event ends. The higher the tier, the more damage the Explosive Traps deal.

Treasure Bag (Betsy).name: Treasure Bag (Betsy)
Treasure Bag (Betsy).tooltip: Treasure Bags are consumable grab bag -like items obtained in Expert Mode and Master Mode as a reward for defeating bosses . The contents and appearance of Treasure Bags depend on the boss it comes from, and are opened by using either ⚷ Open / Activate while inside the inventory , or ⚒ Use / Attack when selected in the hotbar . In multiplayer , each player that deals damage to the boss receives one Treasure Bag upon defeating it. Treasure Bags are client-side and will despawn upon exiting the world. See Notes for details.

In total, there are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 33 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 24 trophies.

Music Box (Old One's Army).name: Music Box (Old One's Army)
Music Box (Old One's Army).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Betsy's Wrath.name: Betsy's Wrath

Valhalla Knight's Helm.name: Valhalla Knight's Helm
Valhalla Knight's Helm.tooltip: Valhalla Knight armor is a Hardmode , post- Golem melee/summoner armor set consisting of the Valhalla Knight's Helm , Valhalla Knight's Breastplate , and Valhalla Knight's Greaves . The set can be purchased from the Tavernkeep for a total of 1500000* 150 .

Betsy's Wings.name: Betsy's Wings
Betsy's Wings.tooltip: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage . After flight time has run out, holding the ↷ Jump button allows the player to glide, slowing falling speed. Flight time resets when the player stands, climbs (e.g. using Rope or Shoe Spikes ), or hooks onto a block. Flight is much more controlled with wings than with Rocket Boots and the like, and they allow for much greater flight range. The player can only equip one set of wings at a time.

Crystal Chest.name: Crystal Chest
Crystal Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Golden Chest.name: Golden Chest
Golden Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Trapped Crystal Chest.name: Trapped Crystal Chest
Trapped Crystal Chest.tooltip: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest . It cannot be used for storage , as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire .

Trapped Golden Chest.name: Trapped Golden Chest
Trapped Golden Chest.tooltip: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest . It cannot be used for storage , as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire .

Crystal Door.name: Crystal Door
Crystal Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Crystal Chair.name: Crystal Chair
Crystal Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Crystal Candle.name: Crystal Candle
Crystal Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Crystal Lantern.name: Crystal Lantern
Crystal Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Crystal Lamp.name: Crystal Lamp
Crystal Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Crystal Candelabra.name: Crystal Candelabra
Crystal Candelabra.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Crystal Chandelier.name: Crystal Chandelier
Crystal Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Crystal Bathtub.name: Crystal Bathtub
Crystal Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Crystal Sink.name: Crystal Sink
Crystal Sink.tooltip: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station . It does not fulfill a house 's flat surface or comfort item requirement, however, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

Crystal Bed.name: Crystal Bed
Crystal Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Crystal Clock.name: Crystal Clock
Crystal Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Crystal Platform.name: Crystal Platform
Crystal Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Spider Bed.name: Spider Bed
Spider Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Spider Bookcase.name: Spider Bookcase
Spider Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Spider Dresser.name: Spider Dresser
Spider Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Spider Candelabra.name: Spider Candelabra
Spider Candelabra.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Spider Candle.name: Spider Candle
Spider Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Spider Chair.name: Spider Chair
Spider Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Spider Chandelier.name: Spider Chandelier
Spider Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Spider Chest.name: Spider Chest
Spider Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Spider Clock.name: Spider Clock
Spider Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Spider Door.name: Spider Door
Spider Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Spider Lamp.name: Spider Lamp
Spider Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Spider Lantern.name: Spider Lantern
Spider Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Spider Piano.name: Spider Piano
Spider Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Spider Platform.name: Spider Platform
Spider Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Spider Sink.name: Spider Sink
Spider Sink.tooltip: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station . It does not fulfill a house 's flat surface or comfort item requirement, however, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

Spider Sofa.name: Spider Sofa
Spider Sofa.tooltip: Sofas are vanity furniture items. There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 38 / (Old-gen console version) 21 craftable sofas and 5 noncraftable sofas. All are functionally identical, and differ only in their appearance. Sofas count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house for an NPC .

Spider Table.name: Spider Table
Spider Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Spider Work Bench.name: Spider Work Bench
Spider Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Trapped Spider Chest.name: Trapped Spider Chest
Trapped Spider Chest.tooltip: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest . It cannot be used for storage , as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire .

Iron Brick.name: Iron Brick
Iron Brick.tooltip: Iron Brick is a type of Brick crafted from Iron Ore.

Iron Brick Wall.name: Iron Brick Wall
Iron Brick Wall.tooltip: Iron Brick Wall is a type of background wall.

Lead Brick.name: Lead Brick
Lead Brick.tooltip: Lead Brick is a type of Brick crafted from Lead Ore.

Lead Brick Wall.name: Lead Brick Wall
Lead Brick Wall.tooltip: Lead Brick Wall is a type of background wall.

Lesion Block.name: Lesion Block
Lesion Block.tooltip: The Lesion Block is a Hardmode block. It is used to craft Lesion furniture and Lesion Block Walls.

Lesion Block Wall.name: Lesion Block Wall
Lesion Block Wall.tooltip: The Lesion Block Wall is a type of background walls.

Crimstone Brick.name: Crimstone Brick

Smooth Sandstone.name: Smooth Sandstone
Smooth Sandstone.tooltip: Smooth Sandstone is a type of block crafted from Sandstone Blocks.

Blood Moon Monolith.name: Blood Moon Monolith
Blood Moon Monolith.tooltip: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during events or under other special circumstances. When placed, they can be toggled with the ⚷ Open / Activate button or via wire , like other mechanisms , providing their effects in a small area around them. They can also be equipped as vanity accessories , which enables their effect globally for the player, similarly to the Radio Thing .

Dunerider Boots.name: Dunerider Boots
Dunerider Boots.tooltip: The Dunerider Boots are an accessory. It can be found in Sandstone Chests in the top 4/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Dunerider Boots.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (25%)

Rain Song.name: Rain Song
Rain Song.tooltip: The Rain Song is a novelty instrument that has a 1/100 (1%) chance of being dropped by Flying Fish, which spawn during rain.

Skull Bow.name: Skull Bow
Skull Bow.tooltip: The Skull Bow is an unobtainable bow. Apart from standard bow behavior, it can convert Bone Arrows (ID 474) into Bone Arrows from the Marrow (ID 117).

Fossil Pickaxe.name: Fossil Pickaxe
Fossil Pickaxe.tooltip: The Fossil Pickaxe is a pre-Hardmode pickaxe. It can mine blocks up to Demonite Ore, Crimtane Ore, and Obsidian.

Super Star Shooter.name: Super Star Shooter
Super Star Shooter.tooltip: The Super Star Shooter is a Hardmode ranged weapon that, as a direct upgrade to the Star Cannon, consumes Fallen Stars as ammunition by firing them in a straight line.

Storm Spear.name: Storm Spear
Storm Spear.tooltip: The Storm Spear is a pre-Hardmode spear that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Storm Spear.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (33.33%)

Thunder Zapper.name: Thunder Zapper
Thunder Zapper.tooltip: The Thunder Zapper is a pre-Hardmode wand that can be found in Sandstone Chests in the lower 3/7ths of the Underground Desert and in Oasis Crates and Mirage Crates obtained from fishing in the Oasis.
Thunder Zapper.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (33.33%)

Drum Set.name: Drum Set
Drum Set.tooltip: The Drum Set is a novelty furniture item used in conjunction with the Drumstick to produce drum sounds.

Picnic Table.name: Picnic Table
Picnic Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Fancy Picnic Table.name: Fancy Picnic Table
Fancy Picnic Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Desert Minecart.name: Desert Minecart
Desert Minecart.tooltip: Minecarts are mounts that allow players to ride on Minecart Tracks . When the player is near a Minecart Track, pressing the Quick Mount hotkey or pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate key on a point on the track causes a Minecart to spawn, which the player is automatically placed in. Once inside, the ▶ Right and ◀ Left direction keys either accelerate, decelerate, or reverse the cart's movement. The cart will maintain its current speed and direction if no keys are pressed and no obstacles are reached. The cart can also "jump" with the ↷ Jump key.

Minecarp.name: Minecarp
Minecarp.tooltip: Minecarts are mounts that allow players to ride on Minecart Tracks . Pink Fairy.name: Pink Fairy
Pink Fairy.tooltip: The Pink Fairy , Green Fairy , and Blue Fairy are critters which will attempt to lead the player to valuable treasures, such as Life Crystals , Chests , or ore deposits. They spawn in the bottom half of the Underground layer and in the Cavern layer, but only if at least one Fallen Log is present in the world on the surface (see Fallen Log § Notes for the exact area). If all Fallen Logs have been destroyed, they will no longer spawn independently. The three fairy variants all function identically.

Junonia Shell.name: Junonia Shell
Junonia Shell.tooltip: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Lightning Whelk Shell.name: Lightning Whelk Shell
Lightning Whelk Shell.tooltip: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Tulip Shell.name: Tulip Shell
Tulip Shell.tooltip: Seashells are decorative items that can be found in the Ocean biomes. They can spawn on Sand Blocks within the biome, both on the beach and underwater. When placed, they can appear as one of three variants.

Pin Wheel.name: Pin Wheel
Pin Wheel.tooltip: The Pin Wheel is a novelty furniture. When placed, the wheel spins if it is windy, with its spin speed depending on the current wind speed in the area.

Weather Vane.name: Weather Vane
Weather Vane.tooltip: The Weather Vane is a decoration piece that will periodically sway in the wind if placed above 0 depth and without a background wall behind it.

Void Vault.name: Void Vault
Void Vault.tooltip: The Void Vault is a placeable portable storage item that extends the player's inventory in a manner similar to the Piggy Bank, Safe, and Defender's Forge.

Music Box (Ocean Night).name: Music Box (Ocean Night)
Music Box (Ocean Night).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

White Pin Flag.tooltip: Pin Flags are furniture items used in golfing . They are purely decorative and come in multiple colors. They can be purchased from the Golfer for 20 SC each.

Golf Tee.name: Golf Tee
Golf Tee.tooltip: The Golf Tee is a furniture item used in golfing purchased from the Golfer for 1 GC.

Shell Pile.name: Shell Pile
Shell Pile.tooltip: Shell Piles are a decorative block found naturally in the Ocean biome in large clumps.

Anti-Portal Block.name: Anti-Portal Block
Anti-Portal Block.tooltip: The Anti-Portal Block is a Hardmode block that prevents portals from the Portal Gun or Portal Gun Station to form on it.

Golf Club (Putter).name: Golf Club (Putter)
Golf Club (Putter).tooltip: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.

Golf Club (Wedge).name: Golf Club (Wedge)
Golf Club (Wedge).tooltip: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.

Golf Club (Driver).name: Golf Club (Driver)
Golf Club (Driver).tooltip: Golf Clubs are tools used in the golf minigame. There are four types of Golf Clubs, the Driver, Iron, Wedge, and Putter, which are each used to hit the Golf Ball a different horizontal and vertical distance.

Golf Whistle.name: Golf Whistle
Golf Whistle.tooltip: The Golf Whistle is a tool used in golf that allows a player to recover Golf Balls, returning it to the previous position before it was hit when used.

Ebonwood Toilet.name: Ebonwood Toilet
Ebonwood Toilet.tooltip: Toilets are furniture items which can be placed on the ground. They are functionally similar to chairs , and count as comfort items for NPC house requirements. In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations. Only the Toilet and Golden Toilet are considered as a valid crafting station .

Spider Nest Block.name: Spider Nest Block
Spider Nest Block.tooltip: Spider Nest Blocks are Hardmode blocks crafted from one Spider Fang and 10 Cobwebs at a Work Bench.

Spider Nest Wall.name: Spider Nest Wall
Spider Nest Wall.tooltip: Spider Nest Wall is a type of wall. As with most placed walls, it is compatible with NPC housing and will stop enemies from spawning.

Meteor Toilet.name: Meteor Toilet
Meteor Toilet.tooltip: Toilets are furniture items which can be placed on the ground. They are functionally similar to chairs , and count as comfort items for NPC house requirements. In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations. Only the Toilet and Golden Toilet are considered as a valid crafting station .

Decay Chamber.name: Decay Chamber
Decay Chamber.tooltip: The Decay Chamber is a Hardmode crafting station used to craft Lesion furniture (Corruption-themed furniture) out of Lesion Blocks.

Terragrim.name: Terragrim
Terragrim.tooltip: The Terragrim is a pre-Hardmode melee weapon. When used, it rapidly releases slashes aimed towards the cursor.

Solar Bathtub.name: Solar Bathtub
Solar Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Solar Bed.name: Solar Bed
Solar Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Solar Bookcase.name: Solar Bookcase
Solar Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Solar Dresser.name: Solar Dresser
Solar Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Solar Candelabra.name: Solar Candelabra
Solar Candelabra.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Solar Candle.name: Solar Candle
Solar Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Solar Chair.name: Solar Chair
Solar Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Solar Chandelier.name: Solar Chandelier
Solar Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Solar Chest.name: Solar Chest
Solar Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Solar Clock.name: Solar Clock
Solar Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Solar Door.name: Solar Door

Music Box (Day Remix).name: Music Box (Day Remix)
Music Box (Day Remix).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Cracked Blue Brick.name: Cracked Blue Brick
Cracked Blue Brick.tooltip: Cracked Dungeon Bricks are bricks which can be found in the Dungeon and appear very similar to ordinary Dungeon Bricks . If jumped on, walked across, grappled to, mined with any pickaxe or drill , or hit by projectiles , several Cracked Dungeon Bricks nearby the targeted block, including the block itself, may fall and be destroyed upon hitting solid ground, dropping no item. Cracked Dungeon Bricks can conceal important pathways to significant portions of the Dungeon, potentially making it seem much smaller than it actually is. Additionally, naturally-generated Cracked Dungeon Bricks often conceal rectangular pits lined with Spikes , which may sometimes be filled with water to make escape more difficult.

Amber Robe.name: Amber Robe
Amber Robe.tooltip: The Amber Robe is an armor item that can be worn in the shirt slot.

Amber Hook.name: Amber Hook
Amber Hook.tooltip: Hooks are a class of tools which aid the player in traversing terrain. When used, hooks fire a chain that latches to a surface or platform and pulls the player towards it. A hook is an essential tool which offers significant freedom from terrain height restrictions as well as being a fast movement option, and will often be the first major mobility tool a player acquires. A variety of hooks are available at all stages of the game (see table below).

Orange Phaseblade.name: Orange Phaseblade
Orange Phaseblade.tooltip: Phaseblades are a group of pre-Hardmode broadswords . There are seven different color variations with identical statistics. All phaseblades emit a small amount of light when swung.

Orange Phasesaber.name: Orange Phasesaber
Orange Phasesaber.tooltip: Phasesabers are a group of Hardmode broadswords and the direct upgrades to the phaseblades . There are seven different color variations with identical statistics. All phasesabers emit a small amount of light when swung.

Orange Stained Glass.name: Orange Stained Glass
Orange Stained Glass.tooltip: Stained Glass are a group of walls made from combining gems with Glass Walls . They work like the normal Glass Wall besides changing the color of the sunlight to match that of the stained glass. Multicolored Stained Glass causes sunlight to shift through the color spectrum in a similar manner to Rainbow Brick , although dimmer.

Orange Pressure Plate.name: Orange Pressure Plate
Orange Pressure Plate.tooltip: Pressure Plates are activation mechanisms that trigger wired mechanisms when stepped on. A pressure plate's color determines which characters can trigger it.

Snake Charmer's Flute.name: Snake Charmer's Flute
Snake Charmer's Flute.tooltip: The Snake Charmer's Flute is a pre-Hardmode tool that places a pot from which a snake rises.
Snake Charmer's Flute.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (25%)

Magic Conch.name: Magic Conch
Magic Conch.tooltip: The Magic Conch is a tool that teleports the player to the Ocean that is furthest away from them.
Magic Conch.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (25%)

Golf Cart Keys.name: Golf Cart Keys
Golf Cart Keys.tooltip: The Golf Cart Keys are a post-Skeletron mount-summoning item that places the player in a rideable Golf Cart.

Golf Chest.name: Golf Chest
Golf Chest.tooltip: Chests are storage items that each hold up to 40 item stacks in rows of 10×4 / 8×5. Chests can be broken with any pickaxe or drill , but only when empty. It is impossible to destroy the blocks underneath a placed Chest.

Trapped Golf Chest.name: Trapped Golf Chest
Trapped Golf Chest.tooltip: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest . It cannot be used for storage , as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire .

Sandstone Chest.name: Sandstone Chest
Sandstone Chest.tooltip: The Sandstone Chest is a storage item found in the Underground Desert.

Trapped Sandstone Chest.name: Trapped Sandstone Chest
Trapped Sandstone Chest.tooltip: A Trapped Chest is a mechanical item that has the appearance of a normal chest . It cannot be used for storage , as it does not have any storage slots. When it is opened, it emits a signal and can be connected with wire .

Sanguine Staff.name: Sanguine Staff
Sanguine Staff.tooltip: The Sanguine Staff is a Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Sanguine Bat minion.

Blood Thorn.name: Blood Thorn
Blood Thorn.tooltip: The Blood Thorn is a Hardmode magic weapon that summons three penetrating Blood Thorn projectiles upon use, which erupt from solid blocks and platforms to damage enemies near the player's cursor.

Bloody Tear.name: Bloody Tear
Bloody Tear.tooltip: The Bloody Tear is an event-summoning item used to summon a Blood Moon.
Bloody Tear.drops_summary: Blood Eel (4%), Blood Zombie (1%), Clown (10%), +7 more

Drippler Crippler.name: Drippler Crippler
Drippler Crippler.tooltip: The Drippler Crippler is a Hardmode flail that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Blood Eels.

Vampire Frog Staff.name: Vampire Frog Staff
Vampire Frog Staff.tooltip: The Vampire Frog Staff is a pre-Hardmode summon weapon that summons a Vampire Frog minion.

Gold Goldfish.name: Gold Goldfish
Gold Goldfish.tooltip: The Gold Goldfish is a harmless critter. It is a golden recolor of the ordinary Goldfish, with a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of spawning in place of the ordinary version.

Gold Fish Bowl.name: Gold Fish Bowl
Gold Fish Bowl.tooltip: The Fish Bowl , Gold Fish Bowl (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , Pupfish Bowl (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) , and Lava Serpent Bowl (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) are decorative furniture items. The Fish Bowl and Gold Fish Bowl also double as wearable items that can be equipped in the player's helmet slot.

Bast Statue.name: Bast Statue
Bast Statue.tooltip: The Bast Statue is a furniture item that grants The Bast Defense buff to players in its vicinity, increasing their defense by 5.
Bast Statue.drops_summary: Mirage Crate (12.5%), Oasis Crate (12.5%), Sandstone Chest (33.33%)

Sandstone Bathtub.name: Sandstone Bathtub
Sandstone Bathtub.tooltip: The Bathtub is a decorative furniture item. It fulfills a house 's requirement of a flat-surface item .

Sandstone Bed.name: Sandstone Bed
Sandstone Bed.tooltip: Beds are furniture items which allow the player to set a new spawn point by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the foot half of the Bed. This requires it to be placed in a mostly valid house (see details below ). On the Desktop version , Console version , and Mobile version , Beds furthermore allow the player to sleep in them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on the head half of the Bed. This makes time pass five times faster and gives a boost to health regeneration , similar to chairs and Sofas .

Sandstone Bookcase.name: Sandstone Bookcase
Sandstone Bookcase.tooltip: Bookcases are a type of furniture and crafting station used for the crafting of three Hardmode magic weapons : the Crystal Storm , Cursed Flames , and Golden Shower . Bookcases also fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement.

Sandstone Dresser.name: Sandstone Dresser
Sandstone Dresser.tooltip: Dressers are a type of furniture (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) as well as a storage item . It will also fulfill a house 's flat-surface item requirement.

Sandstone Candelabra.name: Sandstone Candelabra
Sandstone Candelabra.tooltip: Candelabras are a type of furniture and light source that emits light when placed on a flat surface such as blocks , platforms , and flat furniture items. It is not destroyed by water .

Sandstone Candle.name: Sandstone Candle
Sandstone Candle.tooltip: Candles are a type of furniture and light source . Candles can be placed on Tables , Platforms , Crates or Work Benches . Candles will produce light underwater if placed and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms .

Sandstone Chair.name: Sandstone Chair
Sandstone Chair.tooltip: The Chair is a type of furniture item that can be placed on the ground. They count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house suitable for an NPC . In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations.

Sandstone Chandelier.name: Sandstone Chandelier
Sandstone Chandelier.tooltip: Chandeliers are a type of furniture and light source suitable for house lighting requirements that hang from the ceiling. Chandeliers come in many varieties which differ only in appearance and sell value. All chandeliers can be picked up using a pickaxe , drill , or explosives . Chandeliers take up a 3×3 area of tile space and can be turned on and off using mechanisms .

Sandstone Clock.name: Sandstone Clock
Sandstone Clock.tooltip: Grandfather Clocks are furniture items which provide information about the in-game time . If a player is nearby a Grandfather Clock (about 80 tiles horizontally and 50 tiles vertically), the time is displayed on the right side of the screen, underneath the minimap . The time is rounded to the last hour, similar to Tin and Copper Watches , but pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on it will show precise time in minutes as a status message on the bottom left corner.

Sandstone Door.name: Sandstone Door
Sandstone Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Sandstone Lamp.name: Sandstone Lamp
Sandstone Lamp.tooltip: Lamps are a type of furniture and light source . They also count as valid house lighting and can be toggled on and off by mechanisms . There are (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 37 types of craftable Lamps, three types that are found in the Dungeon (Green, Blue, or Pink Dungeon Lamp), one found in Underworld houses (Obsidian Lamp), and one that can be dropped during a Pirate Invasion (Golden Lamp). All are functionally identical and differ only in their appearance.

Sandstone Lantern.name: Sandstone Lantern
Sandstone Lantern.tooltip: Lanterns are small light sources that hang from ceilings (the underside of blocks ). They occupy less room than a chandelier , making them ideal for smaller spaces. Most lanterns can be toggled on and off via wire .

Sandstone Piano.name: Sandstone Piano
Sandstone Piano.tooltip: Pianos are a type of furniture . They also count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house .

Sandstone Platform.name: Sandstone Platform
Sandstone Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Sandstone Sink.name: Sandstone Sink
Sandstone Sink.tooltip: The Sink is a type of furniture item and crafting station . It does not fulfill a house 's flat surface or comfort item requirement, however, it can be used to craft items that require water as a crafting station.

Sandstone Sofa.name: Sandstone Sofa
Sandstone Sofa.tooltip: Sofas are vanity furniture items. There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 38 / (Old-gen console version) 21 craftable sofas and 5 noncraftable sofas. All are functionally identical, and differ only in their appearance. Sofas count as a comfort item, which is one of the required elements in order to make a house for an NPC .

Sandstone Table.name: Sandstone Table
Sandstone Table.tooltip: Tables are a type of furniture which can be placed on the ground, commonly used in conjunction with chairs . They count as a flat surface item , which is one of the required elements in order to make a house . They can also form a crafting station when combined with a chair.

Sandstone Work Bench.name: Sandstone Work Bench
Sandstone Work Bench.tooltip: Work Benches are a type of furniture and crafting station required to craft many essential early-game items. They are also one possible way to fulfill a house 's flat surface item requirement. Bottles , Pink Vases , and Mugs can be placed on it and used as a Placed Bottle for crafting potions . The Work Bench is the first crafting station the player can make in the game, and one of the first items overall.

Sandstone Toilet.name: Sandstone Toilet
Sandstone Toilet.tooltip: Toilets are furniture items which can be placed on the ground. They are functionally similar to chairs , and count as comfort items for NPC house requirements. In combination with a Work Bench or a Table , they also form minor crafting stations. Only the Toilet and Golden Toilet are considered as a valid crafting station .

Haemorrhaxe.name: Haemorrhaxe
Haemorrhaxe.tooltip: The Haemorrhaxe is a Hardmode hamaxe that has a 1/8 (12.5%) chance of being dropped by Hemogoblin Sharks and Blood Eels.

Void Monolith.name: Void Monolith
Void Monolith.tooltip: Monoliths are furniture items that activate backgrounds and other screen effects normally seen during events or under other special circumstances. When placed, they can be toggled with the ⚷ Open / Activate button or via wire , like other mechanisms , providing their effects in a small area around them. They can also be equipped as vanity accessories , which enables their effect globally for the player, similarly to the Radio Thing .

Arrow Sign.name: Arrow Sign
Arrow Sign.tooltip: Arrow Signs are furniture items used in Golfing. They are purely decorative and come in a regular and a painted variety.

Painted Arrow Sign.name: Painted Arrow Sign
Painted Arrow Sign.tooltip: Arrow Signs are furniture items used in Golfing . They are purely decorative and come in a regular and a painted variety. They are both purchased from the Golfer for 20 SC each.

Master Gamer's Jacket.name: Master Gamer's Jacket
Master Gamer's Jacket.tooltip: The Master Gamer's set is a vanity set consisting of the Master Gamer's Jacket and the Master Gamer's Pants . They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC (set) .

Master Gamer's Pants.name: Master Gamer's Pants
Master Gamer's Pants.tooltip: The Master Gamer's set is a vanity set consisting of the Master Gamer's Jacket and the Master Gamer's Pants . They are purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 10 GC (set) .

Star Princess Crown.tooltip: The Star Princess set is a vanity set consisting of the Star Princess Crown and Star Princess Dress .

Star Princess Dress.name: Star Princess Dress
Star Princess Dress.tooltip: The Star Princess set is a vanity set consisting of the Star Princess Crown and Star Princess Dress .

Chum Caster.name: Chum Caster
Chum Caster.tooltip: Fishing poles are tools used with bait for fishing .

Plate.name: Plate
Plate.tooltip: The Plate is a decorative furniture item that can be placed.

Black Dragonfly Jar.tooltip: A dragonfly jar is a piece of decorative furniture created by combining a dragonfly , captured with any Bug Net , with a Bottle . By throwing a dragonfly jar into shimmer , it can be converted back into its ingredients, gaining back the dragonfly as an item.

Gold Dragonfly.tooltip: The Gold Dragonfly is a harmless critter. It is a golden recolor of the ordinary Dragonfly, with a 1/400 (0.25%) chance of spawning in place of the ordinary version.

Step Stool.name: Step Stool
Step Stool.tooltip: The Step Stool is an accessory used by holding ▲ Up.

Dragonfly Statue.name: Dragonfly Statue
Dragonfly Statue.tooltip: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when connected to wires and activated: Depending on the statue, upon activation it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

Paper Airplane.name: Paper Airplane
Paper Airplane.tooltip: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons.

White Paper Airplane.name: White Paper Airplane
White Paper Airplane.tooltip: The Paper Airplane and White Paper Airplane are consumable ranged weapons . When thrown, they will travel in a different path each time, as they are affected by wind speed and direction, which is especially apparent on a Windy Day . The two variants are functionally identical. They are sometimes dropped by slimes that are carried by Windy Balloons , which can spawn during a Windy Day.

Can Of Worms.name: Can Of Worms
Can Of Worms.tooltip: The Can Of Worms is a consumable grab bag item, which when opened with ⚷ Open / Activate from within the player's inventory, contains 5–11 different worms.

Encumbering Stone.name: Encumbering Stone
Encumbering Stone.tooltip: The Encumbering Stone is a pre-Hardmode tool that prevents item pickup while inside the player's inventory.

Gray Zapinator.name: Gray Zapinator
Gray Zapinator.tooltip: The Gray Zapinator is a pre-Hardmode-exclusive magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 17 GC.

Orange Zapinator.name: Orange Zapinator
Orange Zapinator.tooltip: The Orange Zapinator is a Hardmode magic gun that can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant for 50 GC.

Green Moss.name: Green Moss
Green Moss.tooltip: Moss is a grass -like plant that grows on Stone Blocks . It comes in (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 11 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 5 different variants. Mossy stone requires one more hit to break than clean stone. Moss will be destroyed if the Stone Block it is on converts to Ebonstone , Crimstone , or Pearlstone . Moss sprouts fuzz that can be cut like grass weeds.

Music Box (Journey's Beginning).name: Music Box (Journey's Beginning)
Music Box (Journey's Beginning).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Music Box (Storm).name: Music Box (Storm)
Music Box (Storm).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . Each of the three pearls have different rarities, with the rarer ones being crafted into stronger potions. Additionally, when the Pink Pearl is thrown into shimmer , it turns into a Galaxy Pearl . Stone Door.tooltip: Doors are furniture items that prevent enemies from entering an area when closed. Players can open them by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate on them. Doors can be placed in any space so long as it is exactly three blocks high, with ceiling and floor blocks . Friendly NPCs will also open and close doors during the day as they wander about.

Stone Platform.name: Stone Platform
Stone Platform.tooltip: Platforms are a special type of block that can be walked on, but also allow movement through the space they occupy. The player normally stands and walks on platforms as if they were ordinary blocks, and they can move down through a platform by pressing the ▼ Down key while standing on one. Players can also walk or jump horizontally through the space occupied by platforms, only treating the platform as "solid" when landing on them from above.

Oasis Water Fountain.name: Oasis Water Fountain
Oasis Water Fountain.tooltip: Water fountains are mechanisms that change the color of all nearby water . They can be activated via ⚷ Open / Activate or wire . There is a total of (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) 10 / (Old-gen console and 3DS versions) 8 different obtainable fountains, all of which are purchased from the Witch Doctor for 4 GC each at any time. On the Old-gen console version and Nintendo 3DS versions , they are able to be purchased for free, but are only available after Plantera has been defeated. (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions) The range of a Fountain is (when measured from the edges of the sprite) 60 tiles left, 53 tiles up, 60 tiles right, and 53 tiles down.

Water Strider.name: Water Strider

Gold Water Strider.name: Gold Water Strider

Lawn Flamingo.name: Lawn Flamingo

Music Box (Underground Jungle).name: Music Box (Underground Jungle)
Music Box (Underground Jungle).tooltip: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

Grate.name: Grate

Scarab Bomb.name: Scarab Bomb

Wrought Iron Fence.name: Wrought Iron Fence
Wrought Iron Fence.tooltip: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences.

Bee Minecart.name: Bee Minecart
Bee Minecart.tooltip: Minecarts are mounts that allow players to ride on Minecart Tracks . When the player is near a Minecart Track, pressing the Quick Mount hotkey or pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate key on a point on the track causes a Minecart to spawn, which the player is automatically placed in. Once inside, the ▶ Right and ◀ Left direction keys either accelerate, decelerate, or reverse the cart's movement. The cart will maintain its current speed and direction if no keys are pressed and no obstacles are reached. The cart can also "jump" with the ↷ Jump key.
